    • has multiple versions: whether linked versions has more than 1 item

Parent versioning — given plan ID, linked versions, upsert products, and product states context; gives back a CatalogPlanVersioning:
  Let current version be a max version for plan (plan ID and product states context), or the larger of all of the versions of linked versions if that's empty.
  Let minted be the first version in linked versions where version's version is more than current version.
  Let parent uses all versions mean upsert products has a upsert where all of these are true:
    • upsert's row's plan ID is plan ID
    • upsert's declared licenses is set
    • upsert's row's versioning is "all_versions"
  Let resolved be depending on whether minted is set:
    • if so: "new_version"
    • if not: "all_versions" if parent uses all versions is true, otherwise "existing"
  Give back an object with:
    • current version: current version
    • new version: minted's version, or nothing if that's missing
    • resolved
    • options: parent versioning options:
      • plan ID
      • linked versions: linked versions, keeping only those where version's version is at most current version
      • product states context

To find parent upsert — given upsert products, plan ID, and version; gives back an UpsertProductPlan (or nothing):
  Give back the first upsert in upsert products where upsert's row's plan ID is plan ID and upsert's row's version is version.

To resolve license action — given parent, child, and product states context; gives back a CatalogLicenseAction:
  If parent's declared licenses is set, give back "explicit".
  If all of these are true:
    • parent is set
    • there is a parent of child propagates (child, parent, and product states context)
  then:
    Give back "propagated".
  Give back "unchanged".

Effective child for parent — given parent product and child plan ID:
  Give back the first license in parent product's licenses where license's product's ID is child plan ID's product.

Parent plan change — given parent upsert:
  If parent upsert is set:
    Build plan change from full products, and give back the result:
      • from: parent upsert's row's base full product, or parent upsert's row's current full product if that's missing, or nothing if that's missing
      • to: parent upsert's row's next full product
  Otherwise:
    Give back nothing.

“This child edit will rewrite the catalog link (in-place on this row, or mint/promote).”
Child edit rewrites link — given link and child; gives back true/false:
  If child moves active pointer, give back whether true.
  If there is no child edits items in place (child), give back whether false.
  If link is missing, give back whether false.
  Give back whether link's license internal product ID is child's row's next full product's internal ID.

To build parent version preview — given parent upsert, state product, preview version, child, link, upsert products, product states context, and preview context; gives back a NamedParentVersion:
  Let state key be the product key of state product.
  Let parent state be the state of state key (given product states context).
  Let parent product be parent upsert's row's current full product, or parent upsert's row's base full product if that's missing, or parent state's current full product if that's missing, or state product if that's missing.
  Let license action be depending on whether there is a child edit rewrites link (link and child):
    • if so: resolve license action (parent: parent upsert, child, and product states context)
    • if not: "unchanged"
  Let plan change be a parent plan change (parent upsert).
  Let preview be an object with:
    • everything in a catalog row identity:
      • plan ID: state key's plan ID
      • version: preview version
      • current: nothing if parent upsert's row's op is "create"; otherwise parent upsert's row's current full product, or parent product if that's missing
      • next: parent upsert's row's next full product, or parent product if that's missing
    • name: parent product's name
    • state: an object with:
      • has customers: parent state's customer usage's has versionable customer products
      • will archive: false

        • plan ID: state key's plan ID
        • version: state key's version
        • preview context

  If license action is "explicit" or there is no child edit rewrites link (link and child), give back preview.
  Give back with catalog conflicts:
    • preview
    • current: child's row's current full product
    • next: child's row's next full product
    • relative: an effective child for parent (parent product and child plan ID: child's row's plan ID)

“Collapse the per-version rows of one parent plan into a single lane entry.”

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/preview/plans/planUsage/formatPlanUsageMessages.ts

  Give back "{count's to locale string ("en-US")}+" if count capped is true, otherwise count as text.

  Give back ""{name}"".

To format named bucket message — given singular, plural, count, count capped, samples, singular verb, and plural verb; gives back text (or nothing):
  If count is zero or less, give back nothing.
  If count capped is true and samples is empty, give back "{format count (count and count capped)} {plural} {plural verb}.".
  Let first be the first of samples.
  If first is missing, give back "{singular} {singular verb}." if count is 1, otherwise "{plural} {plural verb}.".
  If count is 1, give back "{singular} {quote name (first's name)} {singular verb}.".
  If count capped is true:
    Give back "{plural} {quote name (first's name)} and {format count (count and count capped)} others {plural verb}.".
  Let other count be count minus 1.
  Give back "{plural} {quote name (first's name)} and {other count} other {singular in lowercase if other count is 1, otherwise plural in lowercase} {plural verb}.".

To format customer message — given count, count capped, and samples; gives back text (or nothing):
  If count is zero or less, give back nothing.
  Let first be the first of samples.
  If first is missing:
    If count capped is true, give back "Attached to {format count (count and count capped)} customers.".
    Give back "Attached to a customer." if count is 1, otherwise "Attached to {count} customers.".
  If count is 1, give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)}.".
  If count capped is true:
    Give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)} and {format count (count and count capped)} more.".
  Let other count be count minus 1.
  Give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)} and {other count} more.".

      1. The first feature usage sample limit of ␀them
      2. Turn each credit system into an object with:
        • ID: credit system's ID
        • name: credit system's name, or credit system's ID if that's empty

“Composes buckets as post-batch surviving references. Plan upserts' overlay (persisted − batch-removed + batch-drafted) is a new input here — not setup/SQL.”
To build feature usage — given feature IDs, preview context, and projected features; gives back a CatalogFeatureUsage:
  Let persisted by ID be preview context's feature usage persisted.

    1. Turn each feature ID into persisted by ID's entry for feature ID
    2. Take the first one where entry is set
  Give back an object with:

    • credit systems: build projected credit systems bucket (feature IDs and projected features)

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/preview/features/featureUsage/formatFeatureUsageMessages.ts
To format count — given count and count capped:
  Give back "{count's to locale string ("en-US")}+" if count capped is true, otherwise count as text.

To quote name — given name:
  Give back ""{name}"".

“Plan / credit-system lines that have sample names.”
To format named bucket message — given singular, plural, count, count capped, samples, singular verb, and plural verb; gives back text (or nothing):
  If count is zero or less, give back nothing.
  If count capped is true and samples is empty, give back "{format count (count and count capped)} {plural} {plural verb}.".
  Let first be the first of samples.
  If first is missing, give back "{singular} {singular verb}." if count is 1, otherwise "{plural} {plural verb}.".
  If count is 1, give back "{singular} {quote name (first's name)} {singular verb}.".
  If count capped is true:
    Give back "{plural} {quote name (first's name)} and {format count (count and count capped)} others {plural verb}.".
  Let other count be count minus 1.
  Give back "{plural} {quote name (first's name)} and {other count} other {singular in lowercase if other count is 1, otherwise plural in lowercase} {plural verb}.".

To format customer message — given count, count capped, and samples; gives back text (or nothing):
  If count is zero or less, give back nothing.
  Let first be the first of samples.
  If first is missing:
    If count capped is true, give back "Attached to {format count (count and count capped)} customers.".
    Give back "Attached to a customer." if count is 1, otherwise "Attached to {count} customers.".
  If count is 1, give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)}.".
  If count capped is true:
    Give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)} and {format count (count and count capped)} more.".
  Let other count be count minus 1.
  Give back "Attached to customer {quote name (first's name)} and {other count} more.".

“Pure: usage buckets → dialog-ready reason messages (non-empty only).”

      • plural verb: "are using this feature"
    • format named bucket message:
      • singular: "Credit system"
      • plural: "Credit systems"
      • count: usage's credit systems' count
      • count capped: usage's credit systems' count capped
      • samples: usage's credit systems' samples
      • singular verb: "references this feature"
      • plural verb: "reference this feature"
    • format customer message:
      • count: usage's customers' count
      • count capped: usage's customers' count capped
      • samples: usage's customers' samples
  Give back everything in a list of an object with message if message is set, otherwise an empty list, for each message in messages.

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/assertInternalIdAgrees.ts

      • product states context
    If slug version is set and slug version is not ref's version:
      Fail with an error: "internal_id {internal ID} is {ref's plan ID} v{ref's version}, but version_slug "{plan params' version slug}" names v{slug version}" [error code's invalid request] (status 400).

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/assertRewardScope.ts

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/detectOrphanedActivePointers.ts

Rows by plan ID — given products; gives back a map of text to list of FullProduct:

  For each product in products:
    Let group be by plan ID's entry for product's ID.
    Add product to group.

“Projected plans still holding a live version while the version customers attach to is archived. Archiving every version is a plan going away and is left alone. Pinned `remove_plans` is exempt: it deliberately archives one version and leaves the pointer where it was (`version-identity-remove.test.ts:107`), and that is the remove machinery's call to make, not this one's.”

    Skip it if active row's archived is missing.
    Skip it if "{plan ID}:{active row's version}" is in removed keys.
    Add an object with plan ID and version: active row's version to orphaned.
  Give back orphaned.

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/detectVersionSlugCollisions.ts

        2. Remove duplicates
        3. ␀them, sorted by value (smallest first)

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/handleDeclaredVariantAnchorErrors.ts

        • variant

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/handleRewardErrors.ts
Invalid — given message:
  Fail with an error: message [error code's invalid request] (status 400).

To assert distinct IDs — given params:
  Let reward IDs be the reward branch of each entry's body's ID, for each entry in params' rewards.
  Let program IDs be the IDs of params' referral programs.
  For each label and IDs in a list of:
    • a list of "Reward" and reward IDs
    • a list of "Referral program" and program IDs
    Let duplicate be the first ID in IDs where the position of ID in IDs (or -1) is not index.
    If duplicate is set, run invalid ("{label} {duplicate} is stated more than once.").

“A reward the catalog cannot express — a free product, an invoice credit — still owns its id. Claiming it would silently rewrite a row the config can never state back, so the push is refused instead.”
To assert IDs not held by unstatable rewards — given params and catalog context:
  From catalog context's reward states context, take unstatable IDs.
  For each entry in params' rewards:
    From the reward branch of entry, take body.
    Skip it if body's ID is not in unstatable IDs.
    Fail with an error: "Reward {body's ID} already exists as a free product or invoice credit reward, which a config cannot state. Rename the reward in your config or remove the existing one from the dashboard." [error code's invalid request] (status 409).

“A stated stable id this env holds must agree with the id beside it. An id it does not hold came from another env, so the entry is matched by id instead.”
To assert reward identities agree — given params and catalog context:
  From catalog context's reward states context, take rewards, programs, unstatable internal IDs, and hidden program internal IDs.
  For each entry in params' rewards:
    From the reward branch of entry, take body.
    Skip it if body's internal ID is missing.
    If body's internal ID is in unstatable internal IDs:
      Run invalid:
        • "Reward {body's ID} states the internal_id of a free product or invoice credit reward, which a config cannot state. Remove the internal_id from your config."
    Let current be the first reward in rewards where reward's internal ID is body's internal ID.
    If current is set and current's ID is not body's ID:
      Run invalid:
        • "Reward {current's ID} cannot be renamed to {body's ID}. Reward ids are fixed; remove the reward and create a new one instead."
  For each entry in params' referral programs:
    Skip it if entry's internal ID is missing.
    If entry's internal ID is in hidden program internal IDs:
      Run invalid:
        • "Referral program {entry's ID} states the internal_id of a program on a free product or invoice credit reward, which a config cannot state. Remove the internal_id from your config."
    Let current be the first state in programs where state's internal ID is entry's internal ID.
    If current is set and current's program's ID is not entry's ID:
      Run invalid:
        • "Referral program {current's program's ID} cannot be renamed to {entry's ID}. Program ids are fixed; remove the program and create a new one instead."

“A stated reward keeps its branch: a coupon never becomes a feature grant.”
To assert branch unchanged — given update catalog plan and catalog context:
  For each upsert in update catalog plan's upsert rewards:
    Skip it if upsert's internal ID is missing.
    Let current be the first reward in catalog context's reward states context's rewards where reward's internal ID is upsert's internal ID.
    If current is set and current's kind is not upsert's kind:
      Fail with an error: "Reward {upsert's reward ID} is a {current's kind with "_" replaced by " "} and cannot become a {upsert's kind with "_" replaced by " "}. Remove it and create a new reward instead." [error code's invalid request] (status 409).

“Every program names a reward this catalog will hold once the push lands.”
To assert program rewards resolve — given catalog context and update catalog plan:
  From catalog context's reward states context, take rewards.
  Let removed IDs be the unique values of the reward IDs of update catalog plan's remove rewards.
  “Unstatable rewards are deliberately absent: a config that could name one could not state the reward beside it, so the program would never round-trip.”
  Let surviving be the unique values of one list combining.
  For each program in update catalog plan's upsert referral programs:
    Skip it if program's reward ID is in surviving.
    Run invalid:
      • "Referral program {program's referral program ID} references reward {program's reward ID}, which this catalog does not have. Add the reward or remove the program."

“A reward a referral program still links cannot be deleted, and the writer finds that out only mid-phase. The push is refused here instead, before the feature and plan writes it would otherwise leave half applied.”
To assert removed rewards are unlinked — given catalog context and update catalog plan:
  If update catalog plan's remove rewards is empty, stop here.
  Let removed program IDs be the unique values of the referral program IDs of update catalog plan's remove referral programs.
  “A program this push repoints stops linking its old reward before the removal runs, so it is not a blocker.”
  Let repointed program IDs be the unique values of update catalog plan's upsert referral programs, after these steps.
  For each remove in update catalog plan's remove rewards:
    Let blockers be catalog context's reward states context's programs, after these steps:
      1. Keep only those where state's internal reward ID is remove's internal ID
      2. Turn each state into state's program's ID
      3. Keep only those where program ID is not in removed program IDs and program ID is not in repointed program IDs
    Skip it if blockers is empty.
    Run invalid:
      • "Reward {remove's reward ID} is linked to referral programs: {blockers joined with ", "}. Remove them in the same push, or point them at another reward."

“Coupons name plans and feature grants name features. The reward writers resolve those only mid-phase, so a dangling reference is caught here against the catalog this push will leave behind.”
To assert reward references resolve — given update catalog plan (async):
  “Features are always fully loaded, so the projection speaks for them.”
  Let feature IDs be the unique values of the IDs of update catalog plan's projected's features.
  “A rename moves every version row, but the projection only carries the new id for the versions the payload restated — an untouched sibling version still projects the old one. Reading each projected id through the rename gives the plan ids this push actually leaves behind.”
  Let renamed to be a lookup table built from update catalog plan's rename plans, each turned into a list of plan ID and to ID.
  Let surviving plan IDs be the unique values of update catalog plan's projected's products, each turned into renamed to's entry for product's ID, or product's ID if that's missing.
  “An id this payload takes away: renamed off its rows, or removed with no version left holding it. The database still answers to it, so the lookup below would call it resolved — it has to be asked first.”
  Let vacated plan IDs be the unique values of one list combining, keeping only those where plan ID is not in surviving plan IDs.
  Let coupon plans be an empty lookup table.
  For each upsert in update catalog plan's upsert rewards:
    Let branch be the reward branch of upsert's params.
    If branch's kind is "coupon":
      Record branch's body's plan IDs under upsert's reward ID in coupon plans.
      Move on to the next one.
    For each grant in branch's body's grants:
      Skip it if grant's feature ID is in feature IDs.
      Run invalid:
        • "Reward {upsert's reward ID} grants feature {grant's feature ID}, which this catalog does not have."
  “An id the push keeps is settled; every other id is looked up once. A vacated id is looked up too, and found — the database is pre-change — so the vacating question below has to be asked before this answer is read.”
  Let unresolved be a copy of coupon plans' values' flat, keeping only those where plan ID is not in surviving plan IDs without duplicates.
  Let known be depending on whether unresolved is empty:
    • if so: an empty set
    • if not: the unique values of the IDs of list full [ProductService] (org ID: the org's ID, env: the env, and in IDs: unresolved)
  For each reward ID and plan IDs in coupon plans:
    For each plan ID in plan IDs:
      If plan ID is in vacated plan IDs:
        Run invalid:
          • "Reward {reward ID} applies to plan {plan ID}, which this request removes or renames. Point the reward at the plan id this catalog keeps."
      Skip it if plan ID is in surviving plan IDs or plan ID is in known.
      Run invalid:
        • "Reward {reward ID} applies to plan {plan ID}, which this catalog does not have."

“A referral program the catalog hides still owns its public id. Claiming it would be discovered only by the writer, after earlier phases have committed.”
To assert IDs not held by hidden programs — given params and catalog context:
  From catalog context's reward states context, take hidden program IDs.
  For each entry in params' referral programs:
    Skip it if entry's ID is not in hidden program IDs.
    Fail with an error: "Referral program {entry's ID} already exists against a free product or invoice credit reward, which a config cannot state. Rename the program in your config or remove the existing one from the dashboard." [error code's invalid request] (status 409).

To handle reward errors — given params, catalog context, and update catalog plan (async):
  Assert distinct IDs (params).

      Move on to the next one.

      • version slug: target's version slug
    then:

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/errors/handleUpdateFeatureErrors/detectFeatureUpdateBlockers.ts
Is credit system switch? — given from and to; gives back true/false:
  Give back whether any of these is true:
    • from is feature type's credit system and to is not feature type's credit system
    • from is not feature type's credit system and to is feature type's credit system

State has entitlements — given state:
  Give back whether all of these are true:
    • state is set
    • state has entitlements or state has loose entitlements

State has entity feature entitlements — given state:
  Give back whether all of these are true:
    • state is set
    • state has entity feature entitlements or state has loose entity feature entitlements

“Batch twin of the live-update blocker matrix (features/utils/updateFeatureUtils/detectFeatureUpdateBlockers) — same codes and priority order, fed from featureStatesContext (+ projected credit ids).”
To detect feature update blockers — given update feature plan, taken feature IDs, feature state, and projected credit system feature IDs; gives back a list of FeatureUpdateBlocker:
  From update feature plan, take current and next.
  From feature change flags (current and next), take is changing ID, is changing type, and is changing usage type.
  Let blockers be an empty list.
  Let has credit systems mean projected credit system feature IDs is not empty.
  If is changing type:
    If current's type is credit system switch (given next's type):
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "type_switch_credit_system"
        • message: "Cannot change type of feature {current's ID} from {current's type} to {next's type}"
    If feature state has customers:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "attached_to_customer"
        • message: "Cannot change type of feature {current's ID} because it has been attached to a customer before"
    If state has entity feature entitlements (given feature state):
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "used_as_entity_feature"
        • message: "Cannot change type of feature {current's ID} because it is used in an entity feature"
    If feature state has prices:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "has_usage_price"
        • message: "Cannot change type of feature {current's ID} because it has a usage price set"
    If has credit systems:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "used_in_credit_system"
        • message: "Cannot change type of feature {current's ID} because it is used in a credit system"
    If all of these are true:
      • state has entitlements (given feature state)
      • current's type is feature type's credit system or next's type is feature type's credit system
    then:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "type"
        • code: "used_in_product_credit_system"
        • message: "Cannot change type from {current's type} to {next's type} because the feature is used in a product"
  If is changing ID:
    If next's ID is in taken feature IDs:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "id"
        • code: "id_already_exists"
        • message: "Feature {next's ID} already exists"
    If feature state has customers:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "id"
        • code: "attached_to_customer"
        • message: "Cannot change id of feature {current's ID} because a customer is using it or has used it before"
  If is changing usage type and next's config's usage type is set:
    Let usage type title be the title of next's config's usage type in lowercase.
    If has credit systems:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "usage_type"
        • code: "used_in_credit_system"
        • message: "Cannot set to {usage type title} because it is used in credit system {the first of projected credit system feature IDs}"
    If state has entity feature entitlements (given feature state):
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "usage_type"
        • code: "used_as_entity_feature"
        • message: "Cannot set to {usage type title} because it is used as an entity feature"
    If feature state has customers:
      Add an object with to blockers:
        • field: "usage_type"
        • code: "attached_to_customer"
        • message: "Cannot set to {usage type title} because it is / was used by customers"
  Give back blockers.

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/compute/computeUpdateCatalogPlan.ts
“Fold ordered compute steps onto one UpdateCatalogPlan. Feature order: update → insert → remove. Updates land in the projection before CS inserts validate schema refs; removes stamp willArchive against the post-upsert projection (minus co-removed rows). Products follow features so plan items can reference same-call features. Plan removes run after upserts so willArchive sees the post-upsert catalog.”
To compute update catalog plan — given catalog context and params; gives back an UpdateCatalogPlan:
  Let original products be the values in catalog context's product states context's versions by plan ID's flat.
  Create catalog compute state (original features: the features and original products), and call the result compute.
  Compute update features plan (catalog context and params), and call the result update features step.
  Run compute's advance (step: update features step).
  Run compute's advance:
    • step: compute insert features plan (params and projected: compute's projected)
  Compute remove features plan (catalog context, params, and projected: compute's projected), and call the result remove features step.
  Run compute's advance (step: remove features step).
  “Plan items resolve against post-feature-ops features (same-call creates/renames). A feature this call removes stays projected when it archives, so existing rows still render; a stated item may not name that row. One the call also updates stays resolvable, so the errors phase reports that contradiction.”
  Let updated internal feature IDs be the unique values of each plan's current's internal ID, for each plan in update features step's update features.
  Let removed internal feature IDs be the unique values of all results, combined, of turning each plan in remove features step's remove features into depending on whether plan's current is set and plan's current's internal ID is not in updated internal feature IDs.
  Run compute's advance:
    • step: compute upsert products plan:
      • context: enrich context with features:
        • features: compute's projected's features, keeping only those where feature's internal ID is not in removed internal feature IDs
      • catalog context
      • params
  Run compute's advance:
    • step: compute remove products plan (catalog context, params, and projected: compute's projected)
  Let plan be compute's to plan.
  From catalog context, take reward states context.
  Give back plan, but with:
    • upsert rewards set to compute upsert rewards plan (params and reward states context)
    • remove rewards set to compute remove rewards plan (params and reward states context)
    • upsert referral programs set to compute upsert referral programs plan (params and reward states context)
    • remove referral programs set to compute remove referral programs plan (params and reward states context)
    • rename plans set to compute rename product IDs plan:
      • params
      • product states context: catalog context's product states context
      • internal ID refs: catalog context's internal ID refs
      • aliases: the org's plan aliases
    • migration drafts set to compute migration draft plans:
      • upsert product plans: plan's upsert products
      • params
      • product states context: catalog context's product states context
      • remove plans: plan's remove plans

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/compute/computeUpsertProductsPlan/computeUpsertProductsPlan.ts
“Derive direct intents → merge stated processors across each lineage → fold each → deriveIntents onto the same pending list. First claim wins, so the merge has to land before every direct intent is claimed. planLicenses compute last, once all plan content is final.”
To compute upsert products plan — given catalog context and params; gives back a CatalogComputeStep:
  From catalog context, take product states context and internal ID refs.
  “A row the payload named is claimed before the fold, so the derived mapping fan-out can never reach it — fill it in up front instead.”

    • intents: derive direct intents (params, product states context, and internal ID refs)
    • params
    • product states context
    • internal ID refs
  Index declared variants (plans: params' plans and product states context) → declared variants.
  Claim product keys (intents: pending intents), and call the result claimed product keys.
  Let all versions plan IDs be the unique values of pending intents, after these steps.
  Create product states fold (original: product states context) → fold.
  Let upsert products be an empty list.
  “Apply each plan's own changes: direct entries plus derived versions/variants.”
  For each intent in pending intents:
    Compute upsert product plan, and take its target product plan and upsert product plans:
      • intent
      • product states context: fold's projected
      • claimed product keys
      • declared variants
    For each upsert in upsert product plans:
      Add upsert to upsert products.
      Run fold's advance (upsert).
    Add everything in derive intents to pending intents:
      • intent
      • upsert: target product plan
      • projected product states context: fold's projected
      • claimed product keys
      • all versions plan IDs
  “planLicenses read other plans' results, so they compute once every plan has.”
  Compute plan licenses plan, and call the result upsert products with plan licenses:
    • upsert products
    • product states context: project plan wide renames (product states context: fold's projected and upsert products)
    • license states context: catalog context's license states context
  Give back an object with upsert products: upsert products with plan licenses.

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/compute/computeUpsertProductsPlan/mergeDeclaredProcessors.ts
“The id the row lives under right now. An entry addressed by `internal_id` states where the plan should END UP, so a rename would index the mapping under a name no intent carries yet.”
Current plan ID — given entry and internal ID refs; gives back text:
  Give back internal ID refs' entry for entry's internal ID's plan ID if entry's internal ID is set (otherwise nothing), or entry's plan ID if that's missing.

“A stated Stripe mapping: an object links, `null` unlinks. Absent = not stated.”
Type StatedStripe: an ApiStripePlanProcessor (or nothing).

“Order-insensitive identity of a stated mapping, for collision detection.”
Stripe mapping identity — given stated; gives back text:
  If stated is missing:
    Give back "null".
  Otherwise:
    Give back "{stated's product ID}|{a copy of stated's additional product IDs, after these steps}".

Revenue cat mapping identity — given stated; gives back text:

    Give back "null".
  Otherwise:

        • product's product ID

          1. Turn each entry into "{entry's feature ID}={entry's quantity, or "" if that's missing}"
          2. ␀them, sorted
          3. Join them with ","
      2. ␀them, sorted
      3. Join them with "|"

“Two entries stating different mappings for one plan is an ambiguity, not a race — whichever the fold visited first would win silently.”

    Fail with an error: "Conflicting processors.{processor name} for plan_id={plan ID}: two entries state different mappings" [error code's invalid request] (status 400).
  Record stated under plan ID in stated by plan ID.

Type StatedStripeIndex: an object.

“RevenueCat mappings are plan-wide, so they never fan out across a lineage — but two versions of one plan stating different product sets still race in the mappings table, which is the same ambiguity.”
To assert revenue cat mappings agree — given plans and internal ID refs:
  Let stated by plan ID be an empty lookup table.

    Claim stated mapping:
      • stated by plan ID
      • plan ID: a current plan ID (entry and internal ID refs)
      • stated: revenuecat
      • identity: revenue cat mapping identity
      • processor name: "revenuecat"

To index stated Stripe — given plans and internal ID refs; gives back a StatedStripeIndex:
  Let by plan ID be an empty lookup table.
  Let by variant plan ID be an empty lookup table.
  For each entry in plans:
    Let Stripe be entry's processors' Stripe.
    If Stripe is set:
      Claim stated mapping:
        • stated by plan ID: by plan ID
        • plan ID: a current plan ID (entry and internal ID refs)
        • stated: Stripe
        • identity: Stripe mapping identity
        • processor name: "stripe"
    For each variant in entry's variants:

        • plan ID: variant's variant plan ID
        • stated: variant Stripe
        • identity: Stripe mapping identity
        • processor name: "stripe"
  Give back an object with by plan ID and by variant plan ID.

“Variant plan id → the plan it bills under. Persisted pointers first (newest row wins), then this call's own pointer writes, which are the state the mapping has to hold in.”
To index base plan IDs — given plans and product states context; gives back a map of text to text:
  Let base plan ID by plan ID be an empty lookup table.
  For each key plan ID and value versions in product states context's versions by plan ID:
    For each product in versions:
      Skip it if product's base internal product ID is missing.
      Find full product by internal ID, and call the result base:
        • internal ID: product's base internal product ID
        • product states context
      Skip it if base is missing or base's ID is plan ID.
      Record base's ID under plan ID in base plan ID by plan ID.
      Stop the loop.
  For each entry in plans:
    For each variant in entry's variants:
      Skip it if variant's variant plan ID is entry's plan ID.
      If variant's base variant ID is missing:
        Remove variant's variant plan ID from base plan ID by plan ID.
        Move on to the next one.
      Record entry's plan ID under variant's variant plan ID in base plan ID by plan ID.
    If entry's base variant ID is missing:
      Remove entry's plan ID from base plan ID by plan ID.
    Otherwise, if entry's base variant ID is set:
      Record entry's base variant ID under entry's plan ID in base plan ID by plan ID.
  Give back base plan ID by plan ID.

“Own entry, then an override aimed at it, then whatever its base states.”
To resolve stated Stripe — given plan ID, stated Stripe, and base plan ID by plan ID; gives back a StatedStripe (or nothing):
  Let visited plan IDs be an empty set.
  Let current plan ID start as plan ID.
  Keep repeating while current plan ID is set and current plan ID is not in visited plan IDs:
    Add current plan ID to visited plan IDs.
    Let own stated be stated Stripe's by plan ID's entry for current plan ID.
    If own stated is set, give back own stated.
    Let override stated be stated Stripe's by variant plan ID's entry for current plan ID.
    If override stated is set, give back override stated.
    Set current plan ID to base plan ID by plan ID's entry for current plan ID.
  Give back nothing.

“Every version of a plan, and every variant that follows it, bills under one Stripe product. Derived `processor_sync` / `variant_propagation` intents carry that across the lineage, but they are dropped for any row the payload already named — first claim wins, and every direct entry is claimed before the fold starts. So fill the stated mapping into those pending direct intents here instead, leaving the derived fan-out to cover only the rows the payload did not name. A row that states its own `processors.stripe` keeps it, including a `null` unlink; only rows that stated nothing are filled.”
To merge declared processors — given intents, params, product states context, and internal ID refs; gives back a list of ProductUpsertIntent:
  Assert revenue cat mappings agree (plans: params' plans and internal ID refs).
  Index stated Stripe (plans: params' plans and internal ID refs) → stated Stripe.
  If stated Stripe's by plan ID's size is 0 and stated Stripe's by variant plan ID's size is 0, give back intents.
  Index base plan IDs (plans: params' plans and product states context), and call the result base plan ID by plan ID.
  Give back intents, with each intent turned into the result of:
    If intent's plan params' processors' Stripe is set, give back intent.
    Resolve stated Stripe, and call the result stated:
      • plan ID: intent's product key's plan ID
      • stated Stripe
      • base plan ID by plan ID
    If stated is missing, give back intent.
    Give back intent, but with:
      • plan params set to intent's plan params, but with:
        • processors set to intent's plan params' processors, but with Stripe set to stated

To merge upsert licenses onto plan — given plan, variant product, and upsert licenses; gives back a DiffablePlanV1:
  Let licenses be a copy of plan's licenses.
  For each upsert in upsert licenses:
    Let index be the position of the first license in licenses where license's license plan ID is upsert's license plan ID (or -1).
    Let existing be licenses' entry for index if index is zero or more (otherwise nothing).
    Let variant link be the first link in variant product's licenses where link's product's ID is upsert's license plan ID.
    Let stock be the API plan v1 sync of variant link's base product, or variant link's product if that's missing if variant link is set (otherwise nothing).
    Let next customize start as upsert's customize, or nothing if that's missing.
    If upsert's customize is missing:
      Set next customize to nothing.
    Otherwise, if upsert's customize is set, existing's customize is set, and stock is set:
      Apply license customize to base plan, and call the result next effective:
        • base plan: apply license customize to base plan (base plan: stock and customize: existing's customize)
        • customize: upsert's customize
      Diff license plan customize (base plan: stock and effective plan: next effective), and put the result in next customize.
    Let version slug be upsert's version slug, or existing's version slug if that's missing.
    Let next license be an object with:
      • license plan ID: upsert's license plan ID
      • version: existing's version, or 1 if that's missing
      • everything in depending on whether version slug is set:
        • if so: an object with version slug: version slug
        • if not: an empty object
      • included: upsert's included, or existing's included if that's missing, or 0 if that's missing
      • prepaid only: upsert's prepaid only, or existing's prepaid only if that's missing, or true if that's missing
      • everything in depending on whether next customize is set:
        • if so: an object with customize: next customize
        • if not: an empty object
    If index is zero or more:
      Set licenses' entry for index to next license.
    Otherwise:
      Add next license to licenses.
  Give back plan, but with licenses set to licenses.

“The base's current→next edit, rebased for this variant. Licenses can't ride the base diff: baseNext.licenses isn't computed yet, and follow must rebase.”
To build propagation edit — given variant product, base current, base next, and declared licenses; gives back a DiffedCustomizePlanV1:
  Diff full products (from: base current and to: base next), and take its upsert licenses (as upsert), remove licenses (as remove), and the rest as content edit.
  If declared licenses is missing, give back content edit.
  Give back an object with:
    • everything in content edit
    • everything in compute upsert licenses for variants (variant product, base current, and declared licenses)

Has content customize? — given customize; gives back true/false:
  Give back whether any of these is true:
    • customize's price is set
    • customize's items is set
    • customize's add items is set
    • customize's remove items is set
    • customize's free trial is set

“A declared variant states its whole row: the base's declared licenses[] are its stock links, re-anchored and customized from the base's entry.”
To apply declared base licenses — given plan, variant product, and declared licenses; gives back a DiffablePlanV1:
  If declared licenses is missing:
    Give back plan.
  Otherwise:
    Merge upsert licenses onto plan (plan, variant product, and upsert licenses: declared licenses), and give back the result.

“Follow applies the base current→next diff onto the variant; customize then patches on top — its license lanes last, so an overlay that drops a base link wins over the base's declared licenses[]. Declared customize alone recomposes over the declaring base row's pre-edit content.”
To build variant edit diff — given variant product, base current, base next, follow, customize, and declared licenses; gives back a DiffedCustomizePlanV1 (or nothing):
  Let current plan be the API plan v1 sync of variant product.
  Let next plan start as current plan.
  If follow is true and base current is set:
    Apply onto, and put the result in next plan:
      • plan: next plan
      • diff: build propagation edit:
        • variant product
        • base current
        • base next
        • declared licenses
  If customize is missing:
    Apply declared base licenses, and put the result in next plan:
      • plan: the API plan v1 sync of base current, or base next if that's missing
      • variant product
      • declared licenses
  Otherwise, if customize is set:
    From customize, take upsert licenses, remove licenses, and the rest as content customize.
    If follow is false:
      Let base plan be the API plan v1 sync of base current, or base next if that's missing.
      Set next plan to depending on whether customize has content:
        • if so: apply customize to plan (plan: base plan and customize: content customize), but with licenses set to current plan's licenses
        • if not: base plan, but with licenses set to current plan's licenses
      Apply declared base licenses (plan: next plan, variant product, and declared licenses), and put the result in next plan.
    Otherwise, if customize has content:
      Set next plan to apply customize to plan (plan: next plan and customize: content customize), but with licenses set to next plan's licenses.
    If remove licenses is set, Remove licenses from plan (plan: next plan and remove licenses), and put the result in next plan.
    If upsert licenses is set:
      Merge upsert licenses onto plan (plan: next plan, variant product, and upsert licenses), and put the result in next plan.
  “Removes are real here: a link only leaves nextPlan when the overlay drops it.”
  Diff plan v1, and call the result edit diff:
    • from: current plan
    • to: next plan
    • include adds
    • include removes
  If edit diff is empty diff, give back nothing.
  Give back edit diff.

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/updateCatalog/compute/computeRemoveFeaturesPlan/resolveAbsenteeFeatureIds.ts

##### server/src/internal/catalogV2/actions/getCatalog/getCatalogV2.ts
Let feature target version be a new API version class (latest version).

With item mapping identities — given plan:
  Give back plan, but with:

“Read the entire catalog — features plus latest top-level plans with variant/license edges.”
To get catalog v2 — given params; gives back a GetCatalogResponse (async):
  From params, or an empty object if that's missing, take include archived (default false) and include versions (default false).
  List full [ProductService], and call the result products:
    • org ID: the org's ID
    • env: the env
    • archived: nothing if include archived is true; otherwise false
    • return all: include versions
  “Variants surface only nested under their base plan, never top-level.”
  Let base products be products, keeping only those where product's base internal product ID is missing.
  To prune archived variants — given product; gives back a FullProduct:
    Give back product, but with:
      • variants set to product's variants, keeping only those where include archived is true or variant's archived is missing
  “One read for the whole catalog: RC mappings live in their own table, keyed by plan id with no version dimension. Variants are their own products with their own plan ids, so their rows are in here too — hand the whole map down rather than a single row, or a variant's mapping can never be read back.”
  Get all [RCMappingService] (org ID: the org's ID and env: the env), and call the result revenuecat mappings.
  Let revenuecat by plan ID be a lookup table built from revenuecat mappings, each turned into a list of mapping's Autumn product ID and mapping.
  Let plans be for every product in base products, all at the same time, collecting the results:
    get plan response
  Let features be the features, after these steps:
    1. Keep only those where include archived is true or feature's archived is missing
    2. Turn each feature into the API feature v1 of DB (DB feature: feature and target version: feature target version)
  Load reward states, and call the result loaded rewards.
  Load referral program states, and take its programs:
    • ID by internal ID: loaded rewards' ID by internal ID
    • statable internal IDs: loaded rewards' statable internal IDs
  Give back an object with:
    • features
    • plans: plans, with each plan turned into with item mapping identities (plan), but with:
      • licenses set to plan's licenses, with each license turned into license, but with:
        • plan set to with item mapping identities (plan: license's plan) if license's plan is set (otherwise nothing)
      • variants set to plan's variants, with each variant turned into variant, but with:
        • mapping identity set to evaluate catalog item identity (item: variant and recipe: catalog variant identity) as JSON
        • plan set to with item mapping identities (plan: variant's plan) if variant's plan is set (otherwise nothing)
    • rewards: loaded rewards' rewards, with each reward turned into depending on whether reward's kind is "coupon":
      • if so: an object with:
        • coupon: reward's coupon, but with internal ID set to reward's internal ID
      • if not: an object with:
        • feature grant: reward's feature grant, but with internal ID set to reward's internal ID
    • referral programs: programs, each turned into state's program, but with internal ID set to state's internal ID

    • everything in an object with plan: core's plan if core's plan is set, otherwise an empty object

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/workflows/storeInvoiceLineItems/storeInvoiceLineItems.ts
“Workflow handler that stores invoice line items from Stripe to the database. Runs async via SQS to allow extra Stripe API calls for subscription item metadata. Two modes: - Full upsert (default): Updates all columns. Used by invoice.created with full Autumn context. - Reconcile only (reconcileOnly: true): Only updates Stripe-authoritative fields (amounts, quantities, discounts), preserving Autumn metadata. Used by invoice.finalized. Also deletes stale line items that no longer exist in Stripe.”
To store invoice line items — given payload (async):
  From payload, take Stripe invoice ID, Autumn invoice ID, billing line items, reconcile only, and emit finalized webhook.
  Try the following:
    Store line items:
      • Stripe invoice ID
      • Autumn invoice ID
      • billing line items
      • reconcile only
  If anything fails (call the problem error):
    Log an error "[storeInvoiceLineItems] Failed for {Stripe invoice ID}: {error's message if error is an error, otherwise "Unknown error"}".
    “A swallowed failure would permanently lose the finalized event; let SQS retry”
    If emit finalized webhook is set, fail with error.
    Stop here.
  “Emit even when storage found no lines: consumers need every finalized invoice”
  If emit finalized webhook is set, Send invoice finalized webhook (Autumn invoice ID).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/workflows/storeDeferredInvoiceLineItems/storeDeferredInvoiceLineItems.ts
“Minimal shape of a Stripe InvoiceItem after SQS serialization”
Type StripeInvoiceItemLike: an object.

“Workflow handler for storing deferred invoice line items (ProrateNextCycle). When a ProrateNextCycle quantity change creates pending Stripe invoice items, there's no Stripe invoice yet — the charges are deferred to the next billing cycle. This workflow stores those line items immediately with full Autumn context and `invoice_id = null`. When the renewal invoice arrives, `storeInvoiceLineItems` will detect these rows by `stripe_invoice_item_id` and update them with the real invoice info.”
To store deferred invoice line items — given payload (async):
  From payload, take deferred Stripe invoice items and billing line items.
  Try the following:
    If deferred Stripe invoice items is empty or billing line items is empty:
      Debug log "[storeDeferredInvoiceLineItems] No deferred items to store".
      Stop here.
    “Parse billing line items and filter to deferred ones (chargeImmediately === false)”
    Let deferred line items be billing line items, after these steps:
      1. Turn each item into the result of these steps:
        Let result be a safe parse [LineItemSchema] (item).
        Give back result's data if result's success is set, otherwise nothing.
      2. Keep only those where item is set and item's charge immediately is missing
    If deferred line items is empty:
      Debug log "[storeDeferredInvoiceLineItems] No deferred billing line items found".
      Stop here.
    Store deferred line items:
      • Stripe invoice items: deferred Stripe invoice items
      • deferred line items
  If anything fails (call the problem error):
    Log an error "[storeDeferredInvoiceLineItems] Failed: {error's message if error is an error, otherwise "Unknown error"}".
    Stop here.

“Converts deferred Stripe invoice items to DB line items and stores them. We have both the Stripe response (with invoice item IDs) and the Autumn billing line items (with full context). We match them via `metadata.autumn_line_item_id` and store with `invoice_id = null` since the items aren't attached to any invoice yet.”
To store deferred line items — given Stripe invoice items and deferred line items (async):
  Let items be Stripe invoice items.

    Record li under li's ID in line item by ID.

  For each Stripe item in items:
    Let Autumn line item ID be Stripe item's metadata's Autumn line item ID.
    Let matched line item be line item by ID's entry for Autumn line item ID if Autumn line item ID is set (otherwise nothing).
    If matched line item is set:
      Add the DB line item of deferred invoice item (Stripe item and billing line item: matched line item) to DB line items:
    Otherwise:

      Add the DB line item Stripe only of Stripe item to DB line items.
  If DB line items is not empty:
    Insert invoice line item repo many (line items: DB line items).

  Give back an object with:

    • Stripe product ID: price details' product, or Stripe item's metadata's Stripe product ID if that's missing, or nothing if that's missing

    • amount

    • product ID: context's product's ID
    • internal feature ID: context's feature's internal ID, or nothing if that's missing

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/workflows/grantCheckoutReward/grantCheckoutReward.ts
“Workflow: GrantCheckoutReward Triggers checkout rewards when a customer completes a purchase. Checks for reward redemptions, validates the subscription isn't on trial, and applies the appropriate reward (free product or other reward type).”
Type GrantCheckoutRewardPayload: an object.

To grant checkout reward — given payload (async):
  From context, take org and env.
  From payload, take customer ID, product ID, and Stripe subscription ID.
  Do these at the same time:
    • customer service's entry for an object with → customer:
      • DB
      • ID or internal ID: customer ID
      • org ID: org's ID
      • env
    • get full [ProductService] (ID or internal ID: product ID, org ID: org's ID, and env) → product
  If customer is missing:
    Warn "[grantCheckoutReward] Customer {customer ID} not found, skipping".
    Stop here.
  Create Stripe client (org and env) → Stripe client.
  Get redemption repo by customer (internal customer ID: customer's internal ID and no triggered), and call the result redemptions.
  For each redemption in redemptions:
    Process redemption:
      • customer
      • product
      • redemption
      • Stripe subscription ID
      • Stripe client

To process redemption — given customer, product, redemption, Stripe subscription ID, and Stripe client (async):
  From context, take org.
  If redemption's reward program's when is not reward Trigger event's checkout:
    Log "[grantCheckoutReward] Reward program not set to checkout trigger, skipping".
    Stop here.
  From redemption, take reward program and referral code.
  From reward program, take reward.
  Log "--------------------------------".
  Log "CHECKING FOR CHECKOUT REWARD, ORG: {org's slug}".
  Log "Redeemed by: {customer's name} ({customer's ID}) for referral program: {reward program's ID}".
  Log "Referral code: {referral code's code} ({referral code's ID})".
  Log "Products: {reward program's product IDs joined with ", "}, {reward's free product ID}".
  If product is not product eligible (given reward program), stop here.
  If all of these are true:
    • reward program's exclude trial is set
    • Stripe subscription ID is subscription trialing (given Stripe client)
  then:
    Stop here.
  If referral code is max redemptions reached (given reward program), stop here.
  Apply reward:
    • customer
    • redemption
    • reward program
    • referral code
    • reward

Is product eligible? — given product and reward program; gives back true/false:
  From reward program, take reward.
  If product's ID is not in reward program's product IDs:
    If reward's free product ID is not product's ID:
      Log "[grantCheckoutReward] Product {product's name} ({product's ID}) not in reward program, skipping".
      Give back whether false.
  Give back whether true.

Is subscription trialing? — given Stripe subscription ID and Stripe client; gives back true/false (async):
  If Stripe subscription ID is missing, give back whether false.
  Retrieve Stripe client's subscriptions (Stripe subscription ID), and call the result subscription.
  Let is trialing mean subscription's status is "trialing".
  If is trialing, log "[grantCheckoutReward] Subscription is on trial, not triggering reward".
  Give back whether is trialing.

  Get referral code repo redemption count (referral code ID: referral code's ID) → redemption count.
  If redemption count is at least reward program's max redemptions:
    Log "[grantCheckoutReward] Max redemptions ({reward program's max redemptions}) reached, skipping".
    Give back whether true.
  Give back whether false.

To apply reward — given customer, redemption, reward program, referral code, and reward (async):
  If reward's type is reward type's feature grant:
    Trigger feature grant:
      • referral code
      • redeemer: customer
      • reward program
      • redemption
  Otherwise, if get reward cat (reward) is reward category's free product:
    Trigger free product:
      • referral code
      • redeemer: customer
      • reward program
      • redemption
  Otherwise:
    Trigger discount:
      • referral code: referral code, but with reward program set to reward program
      • reward
      • redemption

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/autumnBillingPlanToFinalFullCustomer.ts

  “4. Apply entitlement balance updates”

        If update's updates' entities is set, set entitlement's entities to update's updates' entities.

          • entitlement's replaceables

  Give back final full customer.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/billingPlanToPreviewResponse.ts
“Apply preview-layer adjustments (Stripe Tax, Stripe customer credit balance) to the immediate-period total. Mirrors what Stripe will actually invoice: - Tax is added on top of the discounted subtotal. - Customer credit is subtracted, capped at (subtotal + tax) so the total never goes negative. Leftover credit rolls to the next invoice in Stripe; we don't surface that here beyond the row tooltip on the FE. `next_cycle.total` is adjusted separately via `applyNextCycleTaxPreview` (tax only — credits are consumed by the immediate invoice first). If `billingPlan.preview` is undefined (non-attach flows that skip the enrichment step) the math is a no-op and `total` is unchanged. Tax-only next-cycle adjustment; skipped for non-preview flows (no billingPlan.preview bag) so checkout recomputes stay unchanged.”
To apply next cycle tax preview — given billing context, billing plan, and next cycle; gives back BillingPreviewResponse["next_cycle"] (async):
  If next cycle is missing or billing plan's preview is missing, give back next cycle.
  Compute next cycle tax preview (billing context and net subtotal: next cycle's total), and call the result tax.
  If tax is missing, give back next cycle.
  Give back next cycle, but with total set to next cycle's total plus tax's total's to dp (2).

To apply preview adjustments to total — given subtotal, total, and billing plan; gives back an object with total and credit applied:
  Let tax total be billing plan's preview's tax's total, or 0 if that's missing.
  Let credit balance be billing plan's preview's invoice credits' balance, or 0 if that's missing.
  Let taxed be total plus tax total.
  Let capped credit be the result of min [Decimal] (credit balance and the result of max [Decimal] (taxed and 0)).
  Give back an object with:
    • total: taxed minus capped credit's to dp (2)
    • credit applied: capped credit's to dp (2)

Billing plan → preview response — given billing context, billing plan, and next cycle customer product filter; gives back BillingPreviewResponse & { credit_applie (async):
  From billing context, take full customer.
  Let Autumn billing plan be billing plan's Autumn.
  Let all line items be Autumn billing plan's line items.
  Let currency be the currency of billing context (given org: the org).
  From the immediate preview of billing plan (given billing context and currency), take immediate line items, preview line items, subtotal, and total (as line items total).
  Apply preview adjustments to total (subtotal, total: line items total, and billing plan), and take its total and credit applied.
  “Get next cycle object”
  From the next cycle preview of billing plan, take next cycle (as raw next cycle) and debug (as next cycle debug):
    • billing context
    • customer product filter: next cycle customer product filter
  Apply next cycle tax preview (billing context, billing plan, and next cycle: raw next cycle), and call the result next cycle.
  Log billing preview:
    • all line items
    • immediate line items
    • total
    • currency
    • next cycle debug
    • next cycle
  From the changes of billing plan (given billing context), take incoming and outgoing.
  Give back an object with:
    • object: "billing_preview"
    • customer ID: full customer's ID, or "" if that's empty
    • line items: preview line items
    • subtotal
    • total
    • credit applied: credit applied
    • currency
    • resets usage: a billing context resets usage (billing context)
    • next cycle: next cycle
    • incoming
    • outgoing
    • refund: Autumn billing plan's refund plan

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/lineItems/getLineItemBillingPeriod.ts
“Calculates the billing period (start and end) for a line item based on the billing context. The period is the anchor-aligned cycle, which proration divides by. Clipping to when the subscription existed belongs to the effective period, not here. Floor constraint: period end is not before the billing cycle anchor (e.g., trial end date)”
To get line item billing period — given billing context and price; gives back a BillingPeriod (or nothing):
  If price is one off, give back nothing.
  From billing context, take billing cycle anchor ms and current epoch ms.
  From price's config, take interval and interval count.
  “Floor for end: trial end (can't end billing period before trial ends). Only used for long trials (>1 interval) where the natural cycle end would land before the trial end. For non-trial attaches against an existing subscription whose anchor is far in the future, do NOT floor at the anchor — natural cycle boundaries (e.g., monthly add-on on an annual sub) are correct.”
  Let end floor be the future trial end of billing context.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/lineItems/storedInvoiceCreditForPrice.ts
Type StoredInvoiceCreditForPriceResult: an object.

Stored invoice credit for price — given customer product, billing context, target, and consumed charge row IDs; gives back a StoredInvoiceCreditForPriceResult:
  From target, take price and product.
  Let now be billing context's current epoch ms.
  Let charge rows be billing context's stored charge line items.
  Let refund rows be billing context's stored refund line items.
  Let price charge rows be charge rows, keeping only those where all of these are true:
    • customer product's ID is in row's customer product IDs
    • row's price ID is price's ID or row's Stripe price ID is price's config's Stripe price ID
    • any of these is true:
      • product is missing
      • row's internal product ID is product's internal ID
      • row's product ID is product's ID
  Let usable rows be price charge rows, keeping only those where all of these are true:
    • row's customer product IDs is not empty
    • row's effective period start is set
    • row's effective period end is set
    • row's effective period start is at or before now
    • row's effective period end is after now
  If usable rows is empty:
    Warn "[storedInvoiceCreditForPrice] No usable stored charge row for cusProduct={customer product's ID} price={price's ID}; falling back to catalog synthesis".
    Give back an object with line items: an empty list, resolved: false, and covered seats: 0.
  Let current period refunds be refund rows, keeping only those where all of these are true:
    • customer product's ID is in row's customer product IDs
    • row's effective period end is set
    • row's effective period start is set
    • row's effective period start is at or before now
    • row's effective period end is after now
  Let line items be an empty list.
  Let covered seats start as 0.
  Let creditable rows be depending on whether consumed charge row IDs is set:
    • if so: usable rows, keeping only those where row's ID is not in consumed charge row IDs
    • if not: usable rows
  Compute already refunded by charge (charge rows: usable rows and refund rows: current period refunds) → already refunded by charge.
  For each charge row in creditable rows:
    Let period start be charge row's effective period start.
    Let period end be charge row's effective period end.
    Skip it if period start is missing or period end is missing.
    Let action be an augment billing context for anchor reset refund:
      • current epoch ms: now
      • billing period: an object with start: period start and end: period end
      • anchor reset refund: billing context's anchor reset refund
    Add charge row's ID to consumed charge row IDs.
    Add charge row's paid quantity, or 0 if that's missing divided by the larger of the number of charge row's customer product IDs and 1 to covered seats.
    Skip it if action's type is "skip".
    Let effective now be depending on whether action's type is "use_snapped_now":
      • if so: action's snapped now
      • if not: the proration now of billing context:
        • billing period: an object with start: period start and end: period end
        • now
    Let already refunded be already refunded by charge's entry for charge row's ID, or 0 if that's missing.
    Compute prorated credit, and call the result credit amount:
      • charge row: charge row, but with amount after discounts set to split multi entity amount (charge row)
      • now: effective now
      • already refunded
    Skip it if credit amount is 0.
    Add charge row to refund line item to line items:
      • charge row
      • credit amount
      • effective now
      • customer product
      • billing context
      • context override: an object with price and product if product is set (otherwise nothing)
  Give back an object with line items, resolved: true, and covered seats.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/lineItems/storedLineItemUtils.ts
Is within period? — given inner and outer; gives back true/false:
  Give back whether all of these are true:
    • inner's effective period start is set
    • outer's effective period start is set
    • inner's effective period end is set
    • outer's effective period end is set
    • inner's effective period start is at or after outer's effective period start
    • inner's effective period end is at or before outer's effective period end

Has same price? — given a and b; gives back true/false:
  Give back whether any of these is true:
    • a's price ID is set and a's price ID is b's price ID
    • a's Stripe price ID is set and a's Stripe price ID is b's Stripe price ID

Shares invoice — given a and b; gives back true/false:
  Give back whether a's invoice ID is set, b's invoice ID is set, and a's invoice ID is b's invoice ID.

To compute prorated credit — given charge row, now, and already refunded; gives back a number:
  Let period start be charge row's effective period start.
  Let period end be charge row's effective period end.
  If period start is missing, period end is missing, or period end is at or before period start, give back 0.
  Let total charged be charge row's amount after discounts.
  Let refundable be total charged minus already refunded.
  If refundable is at most 0, give back 0.
  Let remaining be period end minus now.
  Let total be period end minus period start.
  If remaining is at most 0, give back 0.
  Let proration fraction be remaining divided by total.
  Give back proration fraction times refundable's neg.

To compute already refunded by charge — given charge rows and refund rows; gives back a map of text to number:
  Let already refunded by charge be an empty lookup table.
  Let chronological refunds be a copy of refund rows, sorted by created at (smallest first).
  For each refund in chronological refunds:
    Let matching charge be the first of charge rows, after these steps:
      1. Keep only those where all of these are true:
        • charge's created at is before refund's created at
        • there is no shares invoice (charge and refund)
        • refund is within period (given charge)
        • refund has same price (given charge)
      2. ␀them, sorted by created at (largest first)
    Skip it if matching charge is missing.
    Let already refunded be already refunded by charge's entry for matching charge's ID, or 0 if that's missing.
    Record already refunded plus the absolute value of split multi entity amount (refund) under matching charge's ID in already refunded by charge.
  Give back already refunded by charge.

To split multi entity amount — given charge row; gives back a number:
  Let IDs be charge row's customer product IDs.
  If IDs has at most 1 item, give back charge row's amount after discounts.
  Give back charge row's amount after discounts divided by the number of IDs.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/initFullCustomerProduct/initPatchedCustomerProduct/initPatchCustomerProduct.ts
“Materializes the added side of a patch-style custom plan update. `setupPatchContext` has already removed the requested customer prices and entitlements from `finalCustomerProduct` and recorded those rows on the patch context. This function initializes customer rows for `customPrices` and `customEntitlements`, carries usage and rollovers only from the deleted patch items, inserts the new rows into `finalCustomerProduct`, and rebuilds the derived `fullProduct` snapshot from that final customer-product state.”
To init patch customer product — given billing context and patch context; gives back an object with final customer product, customer product updates, and one off prepaid carry over customer entitlements:
  Init patched customer entitlements and prices (billing context and patch context), and take its customer prices, customer entitlements, one off prepaid carry over entitlements, and one off prepaid carry over customer entitlements.
  Apply customer product items patch, and call the result patched customer product:
    • customer product: patch context's final customer product
    • insert customer prices: customer prices
    • insert customer entitlements: customer entitlements
    • delete customer prices: an empty list
    • delete customer entitlements: an empty list
  Set patch context's final customer product's customer prices to patched customer product's customer prices.
  Set patch context's final customer product's customer entitlements to patched customer product's customer entitlements.
  Set patch context's final customer product's options to billing context's feature quantities.
  Apply trial context to patched customer product, and call the result trial updates:
    • customer product: patch context's final customer product
    • trial context: billing context's trial context
  Set patch context's insert customer prices to customer prices.
  Set patch context's insert customer entitlements to customer entitlements.
  Add everything in one off prepaid carry over entitlements to patch context's custom entitlements.
  Set patch context's full product to the product of patch context's final customer product.
  “`is_custom` is not set here: it is derived from the resulting item set in applyDerivedCustomerProductIsCustom, once the plan reaches the executor.”
  Give back an object with:
    • final customer product: patch context's final customer product
    • customer product updates: an object with:
      • options: patch context's final customer product's options
      • everything in trial updates
    • one off prepaid carry over customer entitlements

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/utils/initFullCustomerProduct/applyExisting/applyExistingStatesToCustomerProduct.ts
To build balance transition plan — given from customer product, target customer product, and internal feature IDs; gives back a BalanceTransitionPlan:
  Let ID be target customer product's ID.
  Let transitions be an empty list.
  Let mapped source IDs be an empty set.
  For each internal feature ID in internal feature IDs:

      • the number of target customer entitlements is not 1

      Give back an object with:
        • ID
        • outgoing customer entitlements: from customer product's customer entitlements
        • transitions
        • unsupported reason: "multi_entitlement_feature"
    Split source customer entitlements into source customer entitlement.
    Split target customer entitlements into target customer entitlement.
    If any of these is true:
      • source customer entitlement's balance is not a number
      • source customer entitlement's balance is not a real number
      • target customer entitlement's balance is not a number
      • target customer entitlement's balance is not a real number
    then:
      Give back an object with:
        • ID
        • outgoing customer entitlements: from customer product's customer entitlements
        • transitions
        • unsupported reason: "non_numeric_balance"

      • source customer entitlement ID: source customer entitlement's ID
      • target customer entitlement ID: target customer entitlement's ID
      • source balance: source customer entitlement's balance
      • source adjustment: source customer entitlement's adjustment, or 0 if that's missing
    Add source customer entitlement's ID to mapped source IDs.
  Let has unmapped runtime balance mean from customer product's customer entitlements has a customer entitlement where all of these are true:
    • customer entitlement's balance is a number
    • customer entitlement's ID is not in mapped source IDs
  Give back an object with:
    • ID
    • outgoing customer entitlements: from customer product's customer entitlements
    • transitions
    • unsupported reason: "unmapped_runtime_balance" if has unmapped runtime balance (otherwise nothing)

To get entities for existing usage — given full customer and customer product:

    From existing rollovers config, take from customer product.
