##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/setPlans/preview/review/matchReviewPhases.ts
Type ComparableSegment: an object.

Instances at — given segments, at, and just before:
  Give back the unique values of segments, after these steps.

“The instances that start and end at a date, ignoring those running straight through it.”
Transition at — given segments and at:
  Let before be the instances at segments, at, and true.
  Let after be the instances at segments, at, and false.
  Let started be a copy of after, keeping only those where instance is not in before.
  Let ended be a copy of before, keeping only those where instance is not in after.
  Give back a list of started, sorted and ended, sorted as JSON.

“The resulting timeline changes exactly what the saved one changes here, so no phase is touched.”
Is preserved boundary? — given saved, timeline, and at:
  Give back whether the transition at saved's segments and at is the transition at timeline and at.

“Future dates where the saved timeline's set of plans changes.”
Saved phase starts — given saved and now:
  Give back saved's segments, after these steps:
    1. Turn each item (starts at and ends at) into a list of starts at and ends at, and flatten the results into one list
    2. Keep only those where at is set and at is after now
    3. Remove duplicates
    4. ␀them, sorted by value (smallest first)

Gap index — given anchors and at:
  Give back the number of anchors where anchor is before at.

To group by gap — given anchors and dates:
  Let groups be an empty lookup table.
  For each at in dates:
    Let gap be a gap index (anchors and at).
    Record a list of everything in groups' entry for gap and at under gap in groups.
  Give back groups.

“Within a gap, the n-th unmatched request phase is the n-th unmatched saved phase moved.”
Pair moved phases — given request by gap and saved by gap:
  Let moved from be an empty lookup table.
  For each gap and request dates in request by gap:
    For each at (at position index) in request dates:
      Let saved at be saved by gap's entry for gap's entry for index.
      If saved at is set, record saved at under at in moved from.
  Give back moved from.

“The one place request phases meet saved phases: now with now, equal dates with each other, then leftovers between two anchors pair up in order as moved phases.”
To match review phases — given saved, timeline, phase starts, and now; gives back a ReviewPhaseMatches:
  Split phase starts into first phase start (default now).
  Let first phase at be depending on whether a classify first phase start (starts at: first phase start and current epoch ms: now) is "future":
    • if so: truncate ms to second precision (first phase start)
    • if not: now
  Let request starts be phase starts, after these steps:
    1. ␀them from position 1 onward
    2. Pass each one through truncate ms to second precision
  Let saved starts be saved phase starts (saved and now).
  Let anchors be a list of:
    • now
    • everything in request starts, keeping only those where at is in saved starts
  Let changed saved starts be saved starts, keeping only those where at is not in anchors and saved is not preserved boundary (given timeline and at).
  Group by gap (anchors and dates: changed saved starts), and call the result saved by gap.
  Group by gap, and call the result request by gap:
    • anchors
    • dates: request starts, keeping only those where at is not in anchors
  Let moved from be pair moved phases (request by gap and saved by gap).
  Let paired saved starts be the unique values of moved from's values.
  Let future phases be request starts, with each at turned into the result of:
    If at is in anchors, give back an object with at, ends at: at, and comparison: an object with type: "saved" and at.
    Let saved at be moved from's entry for at.
    If saved at is missing:
      Give back an object with at, ends at: at, and comparison: an object with type: "previousPhase".
    Otherwise:
      Give back an object with:
        • at
        • ends at: at
        • comparison: an object with type: "saved" and at: saved at
  Give back an object with:
    • phases: a list of:
      • an object with:
        • at: first phase at
        • ends at: now
        • comparison: an object with type: "saved" and at: now
      • everything in future phases
    • removed phase starts: changed saved starts, keeping only those where at is not in paired saved starts

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/setPlans/preview/review/reviewRowToPlanChange.ts

        Give back a list of an object with before: nothing and after.
      Otherwise:
        Give back an empty list.
    • If it is "ends":
      If before is set:
        Give back a list of:
          • an object with:

            • after: before, but with status set to customer product status's expired
      Otherwise:
        Give back an empty list.
    • If it is "updated":
      If before is set and after is set:
        Give back a list of an object with before and after.
      Otherwise:
        Give back an empty list.
    • If it is "kept":
      Give back an empty list.
    • For anything else:
      Let unreachable be row.
      Give back unreachable.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/restore/errors/handleRestoreErrors.ts
Let allowed subscription action types be the unique values of a list of "update".
Let allowed schedule action types be the unique values of a list of "update" and "create".

“Restore must never create new subs, cancel subs, charge invoices, or release schedules. A "release" specifically signals the schedule was never imported into Autumn — silently releasing it would compound the drift restore is meant to fix. Anything other than no-op / update for the subscription, or no-op / update / create for the schedule, throws. An open-ended plan with a scheduled successor (same entity and group) would reshape Stripe as if it never transitions; other entities' plans on a shared sub may stay open.”
To assert active plans end before successors — given full customer and Stripe subscription ID:
  Filter customer products by Stripe subscription ID, and call the result customer products:
    • customer products: full customer's customer products
    • Stripe subscription ID
  Let scheduled customer products be the customer products that pass is customer product scheduled.
  If scheduled customer products is empty, stop here.
  Let open ended be the first customer product in filter customer products by active statuses (customer products) where all of these are true:
    • customer product's ended at is missing
    • find customer product successor gives back something:
      • source customer product: customer product
      • candidate customer products: scheduled customer products
  If open ended is missing, stop here.
  Fail with an internal error: "[Restore] Customer product {open ended's ID} on subscription {Stripe subscription ID} is active with a scheduled successor but has no ended_at. Set its ended_at to the next phase's start before restoring." ["restore_active_plan_missing_ended_at"].

To handle restore errors — given Stripe billing plan, Stripe subscription ID, and full customer:
  Assert active plans end before successors (full customer and Stripe subscription ID).
  From Stripe billing plan, take subscription action, subscription schedule action, invoice action, invoice items action, checkout session action, and refund action.
  If all of these are true:
    • subscription action is set
    • subscription action's type is not in allowed subscription action types
  then:
    Fail with an internal error: "[Restore] Unexpected subscription action '{subscription action's type}' for subscription {Stripe subscription ID}. Restore only allows 'update'." ["restore_unexpected_subscription_action"].
  If all of these are true:
    • subscription schedule action is set
    • subscription schedule action's type is not in allowed schedule action types
  then:
    Fail with an internal error: "[Restore] Unexpected schedule action '{subscription schedule action's type}' for subscription {Stripe subscription ID}. Restore only allows 'update' or 'create'; 'release' usually means the schedule was never imported into Autumn." ["restore_unexpected_schedule_action"].
  If any of these is true:
    • invoice action is set
    • invoice items action is set
    • checkout session action is set
    • refund action is set
  then:
    Fail with an internal error: "[Restore] Unexpected non-subscription action produced for {Stripe subscription ID}. Restore should only mutate Stripe subscription/schedule state." ["restore_unexpected_action"].

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/multiUpdate/multiUpdate.ts
Type MultiUpdateResult: an object.

Multi update — given params and preview (default false); gives back a MultiUpdateResult (async):
  Log "=============== RUNNING MULTI UPDATE FOR {params' customer ID} ===============".
  “1. Setup: one customer load; per-item contexts are built inside the fold”

      • Stripe billing plan: subscription plan's Stripe billing plan
      • billing context: subscription plan's billing context
  “4. Errors — per item, before any execution”
  Handle multi update errors (item results and Stripe billing plans).

The evaluation context is the first item's context on each subscription with fullCustomer reset to the ORIGINAL customer — the sub plan already carries its items' changes, so applying it to a projected customer would double-apply.”

    Let full product by ID be a lookup table built from group contexts, after these steps.
    Let evaluation context be the first of group contexts, but with:
      • full customer set to full customer
      • full products set to full product by ID's values as a list
      • stored charge line items set to stored charge line items
      • stored refund line items set to stored refund line items
      • refund last payment set to the first context in group contexts where context's refund last payment is set's refund last payment

    • generation registry's entry for tool's prompt fragment

    • "- You cannot ask questions and have no tools. Wherever the docs say to ask, clarify, or call a tool, decide yourself from the most literal reading of the request and produce the single best complete request. Never emit a partial or empty object."
    • "- Never omit a required field. Always set plan_id to your best match from the context plans; when sibling variants exist (e.g. monthly vs yearly), pick the one matching the stated interval or amount, defaulting to the monthly variant."

    • "- When a feature has several items (e.g. an included allowance plus a usage price), the remove_items filter must single one out: add billing_method, or included set to the item's current included amount from the context."

    • "- Prepaid tier boundaries (price.tiers[].to) span included plus paid usage. When changing `included` on a tiered item, shift every numeric `to` by the same delta so each paid tier keeps its size (e.g. raising included 1000 -> 2000 turns to 3000/6000 into 4000/7000). Never drop or reprice tiers you were not asked to change."
    • "- Free trials must set both duration_length and duration_type explicitly (e.g. a 14 day trial is duration_length 14, duration_type 'day')."

“Decodes common tool-call conventions before validation: a single envelope key wrapping the real object, and null / "null" placeholders for unset fields (the "every key present" structured-output convention).       • item #2 of first entry is not a list

  Strip unset placeholders (unwrapped), and give back the result.

“Last-resort decode: the correct payload has always been INSIDE malformed outputs (wrappers, stringified JSON), so search nested values for one that validates rather than enumerating wrapper conventions. Bounded and ordered shallowest-first; a strict-schema false positive is impossible because acceptance IS validation.”

  Give back nothing.

    • starts at: the ms of Stripe subscription's start date
    • Stripe subscription

“Read-only Stripe hydration: for each Stripe billable with a linked subscription, retrieve it ONCE (`.retrieve` only — flash never writes to Stripe) and stash fields the caller may have omitted. Payload still wins; these only fill gaps in the resolvers. An unretrievable sub is skipped so the flash falls back to caller-supplied values.”
To hydrate Stripe billables — given plan contexts (async):
  Let Stripe plan contexts be plan contexts, keeping only those where plan context's processor is "stripe" and the first of plan context's subscription IDs is set.
  If Stripe plan contexts is empty, stop here.
  Create Stripe client (org: the org and env: the env) → Stripe client.
  Let hydration by subscription be an empty lookup table.
  For each plan context in Stripe plan contexts:
    Let subscription ID be the first of plan context's subscription IDs.
    If subscription ID is not in hydration by subscription:
      Try the following:
        Retrieve Stripe client's subscriptions (subscription ID), and call the result Stripe subscription.
        Record build hydration (Stripe subscription) under subscription ID in hydration by subscription.
      If anything fails (call the problem error):
        Warn "billing.import: could not retrieve Stripe subscription {subscription ID} for hydration; using caller-supplied fields" (with error).
        Record nothing under subscription ID in hydration by subscription.
    Let hydration be hydration by subscription's entry for subscription ID.
    If hydration is set, set plan context's Stripe hydration to hydration.

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/dfu/errors/handleFlashErrors.ts
To reject unsupported — given message:
  Fail with an error: "billing.import: {message} is not yet supported" ["unsupported_field"] (status 400).

“Guards deferred capabilities and enforces cross-processor exclusivity. We call executeAutumnBillingPlan directly, bypassing attach's PSP guards, so the cross-processor rule is enforced here.”
To handle flash errors — given flash context:
  From flash context, take params and plan contexts.
  Let all billables be params' billables, plus all the billables across params' entities.
  For each billable in all billables:
    For each phase in billable's phases:
      If phase's starting after is set, Reject unsupported ("starting_after").
      For each plan in phase's plans:
        If plan's customize is set, Reject unsupported ("customize").
        For each balance in plan's balances:
          If balance's rollover is set, Reject unsupported ("balance rollover").
  “Cross-processor exclusivity: a Stripe-owned recurring base plan and a RevenueCat-owned recurring base plan can't coexist. Add-ons and one-offs are parallel cus_products and safe to mix.”
  Let has Stripe recurring base mean plan contexts has a pc where pc's processor is "stripe", pc is not add on, and pc is recurring.
  Let has revenuecat recurring base mean plan contexts has a pc where pc's processor is "revenuecat", pc is not add on, and pc is recurring.
  If has Stripe recurring base and has revenuecat recurring base:
    Fail with an error: "billing.import: a recurring Stripe base plan and a recurring RevenueCat base plan cannot be flashed together" ["cross_processor_conflict"] (status 400).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/dfu/compute/resolvers/balanceResolver.ts

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/batchTransition/compute/operations/customerEntitlementCycleOperations/computeCustomerEntitlementCycleOperations.ts

  From billing context, take attach product, current customer product, scheduled customer product, plan timing, end of cycle ms, checkout mode, feature quantities, transition config, current epoch ms, invoice mode, Stripe subscription, Stripe subscription schedule, is custom, billing cycle anchor ms, reset cycle anchor ms, and trial context.
  Add to extra logs:
    • extras: an object with:
      • attach context: an object with:
        • product: "{attach product's ID} (v{attach product's version}) {"custom" if is custom, otherwise "standard"}"
        • transition: depending on whether current customer product is set:
          • if so: "{current customer product's product's ID} -> {attach product's ID} ({plan timing})"
          • if not: "new attachment"
        • current customer product: current customer product's ID, or "none" if that's missing
        • scheduled customer product: scheduled customer product's ID, or "none" if that's missing
        • plan timing
        • end of cycle ms: format ms (end of cycle ms) if end of cycle ms is set, otherwise "n/a"
        • checkout mode: checkout mode, or "direct billing" if that's missing
        • timestamps: "Current: {format ms (current epoch ms)} | Billing Anchor: {"now" if billing cycle anchor ms is "now", otherwise format ms (billing cycle anchor ms)} | Reset: {format ms (reset cycle anchor ms)}"
        • invoice mode: depending on whether invoice mode is set:
          • if so: "enable immediately: {invoice mode's enable product immediately} | finalize invoice: {invoice mode's finalize invoice}"
          • if not: "default"
        • Stripe: "{Stripe subscription's ID, or "no sub" if that's missing} | {Stripe subscription schedule's ID, or "no schedule" if that's missing}"
        • feature quantities: depending on whether feature quantities is not empty:
          • if so: feature quantities, after these steps:
            1. Turn each fq into "{fq's feature ID}: {fq's quantity}"
            2. Join them with ", "
          • if not: "none"
        • reset after trial end feature IDs: depending on whether transition config's reset after trial end feature IDs is set:
          • if so: transition config's reset after trial end feature IDs joined with ", "
          • if not: "none"
        • trial context: depending on whether trial context is set:
          • if so: "trial ends at: {format ms (trial context's trial ends at)} | free trial ID: {trial context's free trial's ID, or "none" if that's missing} | appliesToBilling: {trial context's applies to billing}"
          • if not: "none"
        • anchor reset refund: depending on whether billing context's anchor reset refund is set:
          • if so: "noPartialRefund: {billing context's anchor reset refund's no partial refund} | refundCycle: {depending on whether billing context's anchor reset refund's refund cycle is set}"
          • if not: "none"

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleAttachInvoiceModeErrors.ts
“Only the intent is stored on the trial, so options that differ from the defaults can't reach the invoice sent at trial end.”
Has custom invoice options? — given params:
  Let invoice mode params be params' invoice mode.
  Let default net terms days be the org's config's default invoice net terms days, or default invoice mode net terms days if that's missing.
  Let has custom net terms mean all of these are true:
    • invoice mode params' net terms days is set
    • invoice mode params' net terms days is not default net terms days
  Give back whether any of these is true:
    • invoice mode params' finalize is missing
    • invoice mode params' invoice template ID is set
    • has custom net terms

“Validates invoice mode configuration against the attach context. Throws when: - Deferred invoice-mode activation is used for a downgrade (planTiming="end_of_cycle"): there is no immediate invoice to pay, so deferral makes no sense. - A no-card trial Autumn bills at trial end is combined with custom invoice options (finalize: false, invoice_template_id, non-default net_terms_days).”
To handle attach invoice mode errors — given billing context and params:
  From billing context, take plan timing, invoice mode, and trial context.
  Let invoices at trial end mean invoice mode is set and trial context is Autumn managed bill.
  If invoices at trial end is true and params has custom invoice options:
    Fail with an error: "Invoice mode with a no-card free trial sends a finalized invoice with the default invoice settings when the trial ends, so finalize: false, invoice_template_id and custom net_terms_days aren't supported. Drop those options, or require a card for the trial." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  If billing context is deferred invoice mode and plan timing is "end_of_cycle":
    Fail with an error: "Cannot use invoice mode with deferred activation for downgrades. Downgrades are scheduled for end of cycle and have no immediate invoice to pay." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleAttachV2Errors.ts
“Validates attach v2 request before executing the billing plan.”
To handle attach v2 errors — given billing context, billing plan, params, and preview (default false) (async):
  From billing plan, take Autumn (as Autumn billing plan).
  “1.1. External PSP errors (RevenueCat) Skipped when the caller IS the external PSP origin (e.g. the RevenueCat webhook handler attaching onto its own RC-managed customer).”
  If billing context do not skip external psp guard:
    Handle external psp errors:
      • customer products: billing context's full customer's customer products
      • attach product: billing context's attach product
      • action: "attach"
  “1.2. Custom Payment Method errors (Vercel)”
  Handle custom payment method errors v2 (billing context).
  “1.3. Seat-holding entities are managed through their license”
  Handle entity license assignment errors (full customer: billing context's full customer).
  “1.4. License linkage preconditions on the attach target”
  Handle license attach target errors:
    • full customer: billing context's full customer
    • attach product: billing context's attach product
  “2. Current customer product errors (same product)”
  Handle current customer product errors (billing context).
  “3. new_billing_subscription validation errors”
  Handle new billing subscription errors (billing context and params).
  “4. Stripe checkout errors”
  Handle Stripe checkout errors (billing context and Autumn billing plan).
  “5. Invoice mode errors (deferred + downgrade, no-card trial invoice options)”
  Handle attach invoice mode errors (billing context and params).
  If preview is false, Handle tax location errors (billing context and billing plan).
  “6. Scheduled switch with one-off prepaid quantities”
  Handle scheduled switch one off errors (billing context).
  Handle billing cycle anchor errors (billing context and params).
  Handle start date errors (billing context, params, and preview).
  Handle end date errors (billing context and params).
  “7. Transition config errors (reset_after_trial_end on allocated features)”
  Handle transition config errors (billing context).
  “8. Carry over balances errors (non-consumable features, downgrade block)”
  Handle carry over balances errors (params and billing context).
  “9. Carry over usages errors (non-consumable features, downgrade block)”
  Handle carry over usages errors:
    • carry over usages: params' carry over usages
    • replaces plan now: whether billing context's plan timing is "immediate"
  “10. Proration behavior errors (none restrictions)”
  Handle proration behavior errors (billing context and billing plan).
  “11. Subscription ID uniqueness”
  Handle subscription ID errors:
    • internal customer ID: billing context's full customer's internal ID
    • subscription IDs: a list of billing context's external ID
  “12. Custom line items errors (only valid for subscription updates)”
  Handle custom line items errors (params, billing context, and billing plan).
  “13. Revert trial errors (card_required + revert, missing existing plan)”
  Handle revert trial errors (billing context).
  “14. Adding and removing the same discount in one request”
  Handle remove discounts errors (params).
  Handle Stripe billing plan errors (billing context and billing plan).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleBillingCycleAnchorErrors.ts
“Validates billing cycle anchor constraints for attach.”
To handle billing cycle anchor errors — given billing context and params:
  From billing context, take requested billing cycle anchor.
  If requested billing cycle anchor is missing, stop here.
  Assert future billing cycle anchor:
    • requested billing cycle anchor
    • current epoch ms: billing context's current epoch ms
  Let scheduled reset at be truncate ms to second precision (requested billing cycle anchor) if requested billing cycle anchor is a number (otherwise nothing).
  Let billing starts at be billing context's billing starts at.
  If all of these are true:
    • scheduled reset at is set
    • billing starts at is set
    • scheduled reset at is at or before truncate ms to second precision (billing starts at)
  then:
    Fail with an error: "billing_cycle_anchor must be after the plan starts" [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  If all of these are true:
    • scheduled reset at is set
    • params' ends at is set
    • scheduled reset at is at or after truncate ms to second precision (params' ends at)
  then:
    Fail with an error: "billing_cycle_anchor must be before ends_at" [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  If all of these are true:
    • requested billing cycle anchor is "now"
    • billing context's plan timing is not "end_of_cycle"
    • billing starts at is future start date (given billing context's current epoch ms)
  then:
    Fail with an error: "billing_cycle_anchor: 'now' cannot be used before the plan starts" [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  Assert no billing cycle anchor with trial (billing context).
  “Cannot use billing_cycle_anchor on one-off products”
  If billing context's attach product is one off:
    Fail with an error: "billing_cycle_anchor is not supported for one-off products. One-off products do not have a recurring billing cycle." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  “Resets are not supported for scheduled switches (downgrades)”
  If requested billing cycle anchor is "now" and billing context's plan timing is "end_of_cycle":
    Fail with an error: "billing_cycle_anchor resets are not supported for scheduled switches. Use an immediate upgrade, or remove billing_cycle_anchor." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleCarryOverBalancesErrors.ts
“Validates carry_over_balances params. - Only valid for immediate switches — errors on scheduled/downgrade. - Boolean and allocated (continuous_use) features cannot have balances carried over.”
To handle carry over balances errors — given params and billing context:
  Let carry over be params' carry over balances.
  If carry over's enabled is missing, stop here.
  If billing context's plan timing is not "immediate":
    Fail with an error: "carry_over_balances is only supported for immediate plan switches (upgrades). It cannot be used with scheduled downgrades." [error code's invalid request] (status 400).
  Let feature IDs be carry over's feature IDs.
  If feature IDs is empty, stop here.
  For each feature ID in feature IDs:
    Let feature be feature utils' find's by ID (features: the features, feature ID, and error on not found).
    If feature is boolean:
      Fail with an error: "carry_over_balances is not supported for boolean features. Feature '{feature ID}' is a boolean (static) feature and does not have a consumable balance.".
    If feature utils is allocated (feature):
      Fail with an error: "carry_over_balances is not supported for non-consumable features. Feature '{feature ID}' is a non-consumable feature and does not have a consumable balance to carry over.".

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleCurrencyMismatchErrors.ts
Price charges — given price; gives back true/false:
  Let config be price's config.
  If config has a "usage_tiers" key and config's usage tiers is set:
    Give back whether config's usage tiers has a tier where tier's amount plus tier's flat amount, or 0 if that's missing is positive.
  If config has a "amount" key and config's amount is set:
    Give back whether config's amount, or 0 if that's missing is positive.
  Give back whether false.

Price offers currency — given price, currency, and org default; gives back true/false:
  Give back price has currency amounts:
    • config: price's config
    • currency
    • org default
    • is fixed: whether price is fixed

To plan offers currency — given prices and currency; gives back true/false:
  If prices is free product, give back whether true.
  Let org default be the currency of the org in lowercase.
  Give back whether the prices that pass price charges has no price where there is no price offers currency (price, currency, and org default).

To assert plan offers currency — given prices, plan name, currency, and customer configured (default false):
  If plan offers currency (prices and currency) gives back nothing:
    Let code be currency in uppercase.
    Fail with an error: depending on whether customer configured is true [error code's currency mismatch] (status 400):
      • if so: "This customer pays in {code}, but plan '{plan name}' has no {code} price. Add {code} pricing to the plan or pick a plan that offers it."
      • if not: "Plan '{plan name}' does not offer a price in {code}. Add {code} pricing to the plan or bill in a currency it supports."

“Blocks an attach that would bill the customer in an unsupported currency. Runs pre-Stripe (before evaluateStripeBillingPlan, which creates Stripe prices).”
To handle currency mismatch errors — given billing context and params:
  From billing context, take full customer and attach product.
  Let prices be the effective prices of attach product.
  If params' currency is set and there is no org multi currency enabled (org: the org):
    Fail with an error: "Multi-currency is not enabled for this organization" [error code's invalid request] (status 400).
  “Free / auto-enabled plans neither need nor lock a currency.”
  If attach product is free, stop here.
  Let locked be full customer's currency, or billing context's Stripe customer's currency if that's missing in lowercase, or nothing if that's empty.
  Let requested be params' currency in lowercase, or nothing if that's empty.
  Let resolved be billing context's currency, or resolve customer currency if that's missing:
    • customer: full customer
    • org: the org
    • requested: params' currency
    • Stripe currency: billing context's Stripe customer's currency
  “A locked customer cannot switch currencies (Stripe forbids it anyway).”
  If locked is set, requested is set, and requested is not locked:
    Fail with an error: "Customer is locked to {locked in uppercase} and cannot be billed in {requested in uppercase}" [error code's currency mismatch] (status 400).
  “Every charging price must offer the resolved currency (no FX fallback).”
  Assert plan offers currency:
    • prices
    • plan name: attach product's name
    • currency: resolved
    • customer configured: whether locked is set and resolved is locked

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleCurrentCustomerProductErrors.ts
To handle current customer product errors — given billing context:
  From billing context, take current customer product, attach product, Stripe subscription, skip billing changes, skip external psp guard, and canceled Stripe subscription ID.
  If current customer product's product's ID is attach product's ID:
    Fail with an error: "Cannot attach because the customer's current product '{current customer product's product's name}' is the same as the product being attached" [error code's plan already attached] (status 409).
  “The "paid but no Stripe sub" guard catches broken Stripe linkage. External-PSP origin callers (e.g. RevenueCat) legitimately have paid current products with no Stripe subscription — they opt out via `skipExternalPSPGuard`. Stripe-origin cus_products with `processor: null` must still be checked, so this is gated on the explicit flag rather than on `cusProductToProcessorType`. A subscription that is linked but canceled is explained linkage, not broken linkage, and neither is an Autumn-managed trial.”
  If all of these are true:
    • skip billing changes is false
    • skip external psp guard is false
    • canceled Stripe subscription ID is missing
    • current customer product is not customer product Autumn managed trial
    • current customer product is customer product paid
    • Stripe subscription is missing
  then:
    Fail with an error: "Cannot attach because the customer's current product '{current customer product's product's name}' is paid but no stripe subscription is linked to it".

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleEndDateErrors.ts
To handle end date errors — given billing context and params:

    Fail with an error: "ends_at cannot be set to a past timestamp. Use a future Unix timestamp in milliseconds." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  Let starts at mean params' starts at, or depending on whether billing context's plan timing is "end_of_cycle" if that's missing is set:
    • if so: billing context's end of cycle ms
    • if not: billing context's current epoch ms
  If starts at is set and params' ends at is at or before starts at:
    Fail with an error: "ends_at must be after the plan start timestamp." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).
  If billing context's attach product is free:
    Fail with an error: "ends_at is only supported for paid plans." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleScheduledSwitchOneOffErrors.ts

Throws when: - planTiming is "end_of_cycle" (scheduled switch / downgrade) - AND the user passed a non-zero quantity for a one-off prepaid price Scheduled switches don't add one-off prices to the next invoice, so we block explicit one-off prepaid quantities until that's supported.”

    Let feature be the feature of price (given features: the features).
    Skip it if feature is missing.
    Let matching option be the first fq in feature quantities where fq's feature ID is feature's ID or fq's internal feature ID is feature's internal ID.
    If matching option is set and matching option's quantity is positive:
      Fail with an error: "Scheduled switch with one-off prepaid quantities is not yet supported. Either use an immediate switch, or omit the one-off prepaid quantity (it will default to 0)." [error code's invalid request] (status status codes' bad request).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/errors/handleStripeCheckoutErrors.ts
“Gets unique recurring intervals from line items (excludes one-off prices).”
To get recurring intervals from paid line items — given Autumn billing plan; gives back a set of text:
  Let intervals be an empty set.
  For each line item in Autumn billing plan's line items:
    Let price be line item's context's price.
    Let interval be price's config's interval.
    “Skip one-off prices”
    Skip it if interval is billing interval's one off.
    Skip it if line item's amount after discounts is zero or less.
    “Create a unique key for interval + interval_count”
    Let interval count be price's config's interval count, or 1 if that's missing.
    Let key be "{interval}_{interval count}".
    Add key to intervals.
  Give back intervals.

“Validates that stripe checkout mode doesn't have multiple recurring intervals. Stripe checkout sessions can only handle one recurring interval at a time. If we have line items with different intervals (e.g., monthly and annual), we cannot create a valid checkout session.”
To handle Stripe checkout errors — given billing context and Autumn billing plan:
  “Only check for stripe_checkout mode”
  If billing context's checkout mode is not "stripe_checkout", stop here.
  Handle Stripe checkout license errors (billing context and Autumn billing plan).
  Get recurring intervals from paid line items (Autumn billing plan), and call the result recurring intervals.
  “If we have more than one unique recurring interval, throw an error”
  If recurring intervals' size is more than 1:
    Fail with an error: "Cannot create Stripe checkout when there are multiple intervals that require payment upfront. Please use direct billing or separate the purchases." [error code's invalid request] (status 400).
  “enable_plan_immediately pre-inserts the cusProduct (with its feature quantities) at attach time. If the customer can change quantities on the Stripe checkout page, those changes won't propagate back to the row, leaving Autumn out of sync with Stripe. Block the combination explicitly.”
  If all of these are true:
    • billing context's enable plan immediately is set
    • the number of billing context's adjustable feature quantities, or 0 if that's missing is positive
  then:
    Fail with an error: "enable_plan_immediately cannot be used with adjustable feature quantities — set adjustable_quantity to false on each option, or remove enable_plan_immediately." [error code's invalid request] (status 400).

##### server/src/internal/billing/v2/actions/attach/compute/computeAttachBalanceTransitionPlan.ts
To reject balance transition plan — given balance transition plan and unsupported reason; gives back a BalanceTransitionPlan:
  Give back balance transition plan, but with unsupported reason set to unsupported reason.

To compute attach balance transition plan — given attach billing context, params, balance transition plan, Autumn billing plan, and has full customer override; gives back a BalanceTransitionPlan (or nothing):
  If balance transition plan is missing, give back nothing.
  If has full customer override:
    Reject balance transition plan, and give back the result:
      • balance transition plan
      • unsupported reason: "full_customer_override"
  Let source customer product be attach billing context's carry over source customer product, or attach billing context's current customer product if that's missing.
  If source customer product's ID is not attach billing context's current customer product's ID:

Type SyncCustomerDirtyPayload: customer ID, org ID, env, region (optional), Redis instance (optional), and timestamp.

“Drains a customer's coalesced sync state (SyncCustomerDirty signal). Claims the dirty state (atomic move to a claim key), flushes the latest Redis balances for the claimed selectors via the V4 flush, then clears the claim. Ordering guarantees: - writes landing after the claim recreate the dirty key and re-signal — nothing written after our read is lost; - a crash before clearSyncClaim leaves the claim for the next delivery (message stays in SQS: transient errors rethrow and are retryable); - an empty claim (already drained / Redis loss) is a safe no-op.”

      • if so: get Redis v2 by instance name (payload's Redis instance), or the Redis v2 if that's missing
      • if not: the Redis v2
  “Coalescing window: FIFO queues don't support per-message DelaySeconds, so the window is enforced here — writes landing between the signal and this claim merge into the same drain. Must stay well under the worker's 25s message timeout.”
  Let window remaining ms be payload's timestamp plus coalesce window ms minus the current time.
  If window remaining ms is positive, a promise.
  Claim sync dirty (Redis and scope), and call the result claimed.

    Debug log "[SYNC V5] ({payload's customer ID}) Nothing to drain (empty dirty state)".
    Stop here.

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/sync/dirtyState/markSyncDirty.ts
“Leak backstop: dirty state a worker never drains expires on its own. Reconciliation (sync conflicts / cache rebuild) covers anything expired.”

“Hash-field encoding of the dirty state (single hash per customer so the claim can RENAME it atomically): ce:{cusEntId}              = "1"        (selector set) ro:{rolloverId}            = "1"        (selector set) fc:{featureId}:{cusEntId}  = "1"        (feature -> cusEntIds map) uw:{featureId}             = JSON       ({ts, snapshot}, newest wins) entityId                   = string     (last write wins)”

  • entity ID: "entityId"

“Merge fields into the dirty hash, refresh its TTL, then attempt to set the signal marker (NX + TTL). shouldSignal is true when the marker was newly set — i.e. no signal is believed to be in flight. A single Lua eval keeps merge+decision atomic against concurrent marks and claims.”

    For each customer entitlement ID in feature customer entitlement IDs:
      Add these to field args:
        • "{dirty field prefixes' feature customer entitlement}{encode uri component (feature ID)}:{encode uri component (customer entitlement ID)}"
        • "1"
  For each ts and update in usage window updates:
    Add these to field args:
      • "{dirty field prefixes' usage window}{encode uri component (update's feature ID)}"
      • an object with ts and snapshot: update as JSON
  If entity ID is set, add dirty field prefixes' entity ID and entity ID to field args.
  If field args is empty, give back an object with should signal: false.
  Let result be Redis's eval:
    • mark script
    • 2
    • dirty key
    • signal key
    • signal TTL seconds as text
    • dirty state TTL seconds as text
    • all of field args

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/refreshEntityAggregate/RefreshEntityAggregateBatchingManager.ts
Type QueueRefreshEntityAggregatePayload: an object.
Type RefreshEntry: customer ID, org ID, env, internal feature IDs, and timer.

“Coalesces `RefreshEntityAggregate` enqueues per (org, env, customer). All `schedule()` calls that arrive inside the same 5s bucket share one timer aimed at the bucket's trailing edge (+ settle buffer). When the timer fires, the manager emits a single SQS message with the merged `internalFeatureIds`. Because we're in the same worker process that consumes the customer's sync-v4 stream (FIFO MessageGroupId already serializes that), this in-memory dedup is effectively per-customer global.”
Class Refresh entity aggregate batching manager:
  Field entries starts as an empty lookup table.
  Field bucket ms.
  Field settle buffer ms.
  Field add task to queue.
  Field now.
  When created — given add task to queue function, bucket ms, settle buffer ms, and now:
    Set this's add task to queue to add task to queue function, or add task to queue if that's missing.
    Set this's bucket ms to bucket ms, or refresh entity aggregate dedup bucket ms if that's missing.
    Set this's settle buffer ms to settle buffer ms, or refresh entity aggregate settle buffer ms if that's missing.
    Set this's now to now, or date's now if that's missing.
  To schedule — given org ID, env, customer ID, and internal feature IDs:
    Build this key (org ID, env, and customer ID) → key.
    Let existing be this's entries' entry for key.
    If existing is set:
      For each ID in internal feature IDs:
        Add ID to existing's internal feature IDs.
      Stop here.
    Let entry be an object with:
      • customer ID
      • org ID
      • env
      • internal feature IDs: the unique values of internal feature IDs
      • timer: nothing
    Record entry under key in this's entries.
    Schedule this timer (key and entry).
  To flush (async):
    Let keys be this's entries' keys as a list.
    For every key in keys, all at the same time:
      fire this (key)
  To get stats — gives back an object with total pending:
    Give back an object with total pending: this's entries' size.
  To build key — given org ID, env, and customer ID; gives back text:
    Give back "{org ID}:{env}:{customer ID}".
  To schedule timer — given key and entry:
    Let now ms be this's now.
    Let bucket end ms be now ms divided by this's bucket ms, rounded down plus 1 times this's bucket ms.
    Let delay ms be bucket end ms minus now ms plus this's settle buffer ms.
    Set entry's timer to after delay msms, do the following:
      Fire this (key).
    If entry's timer's unref is set, Unref entry's timer.
  To fire — given key (async):
    Let entry be this's entries' entry for key.
    If entry is missing, stop here.
    If entry's timer is set:
      Clear timeout (entry's timer).
      Set entry's timer to nothing.
    Remove key from this's entries.
    If entry's internal feature IDs' size is 0, stop here.
    Let internal feature IDs be entry's internal feature IDs as a list, sorted.
    Build refresh entity aggregate dedup ID, and call the result message deduplication ID:
      • org ID: entry's org ID
      • env: entry's env
      • customer ID: entry's customer ID
      • now ms: this's now
      • bucket ms: this's bucket ms
    Try the following:
      Add this task to queue:
        • job name: job name's refresh entity aggregate
        • payload: an object with:
          • customer ID: entry's customer ID
          • org ID: entry's org ID
          • env: entry's env
          • region: current region
          • internal feature IDs
        • message group ID: "refresh-agg:{entry's org ID}:{entry's env}:{entry's customer ID}"
        • message deduplication ID
      Log "[RefreshEntityAggregate] Queued refresh for {entry's customer ID}, {the number of internal feature IDs} features".
    If anything fails (call the problem error):
      Log an error "[RefreshEntityAggregate] Failed to queue refresh for {entry's customer ID}: {error}".

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/lockV2/fetchAndClaimLockReceiptV2.ts
“Marker TTL is a crash-safety net — the marker is always DEL'd on finalize. Chosen well above any realistic claim-race window and well below typical receipt lifetimes so orphans clean up without sticking around forever.”
Let claim marker TTL seconds be 3600.

Type FetchAndClaimResult: an object or an object.

To normalize lock receipt items — given items and lock ID; gives back a list of MutationLogItem:
  If items is a list, give back items.
  If items is set, items is an object, and the keys of items is empty, give back an empty list.
  Fail with an error: "Lock receipt has invalid items for ID: {lock ID}" [error code's invalid request] (status 400).

“V2 merged fetch-and-claim. Pipelines a plain `GET <receiptKey>` and a `SET <receiptKey>:claim 1 NX EX` in a single round trip. The receipt payload is never mutated — claim is encoded entirely by ownership of the marker key. Returns `{ found: false }` when the receipt key is absent on redisV2 (the dispatcher uses this to fall through to the V1 finalize path). When `found` is true, `claimed` reports whether this caller won the race; the dispatcher throws on `found && !claimed` rather than falling through to V1, because a present-but-contested receipt IS a V2 lock.”
To fetch and claim lock receipt v2 — given lock ID and Redis instance; gives back a FetchAndClaimResult (async):
  Let hashed key be hash [Bun] (lock ID) as text.
  Build lock receipt key (org ID: the org's ID, env: the env, and lock key: hashed key) → lock receipt key.
  Build claim marker key (lock receipt key) → claim marker key.
  “Pipeline GET + SET NX EX as a single round trip. tryRedisWrite wraps the whole `.exec()` since any error (or unavailable redis) invalidates both results atomically from our perspective.”
  Try Redis write, and call the result exec result:
    • a function giving back exec set Redis instance's pipeline's entry for lock receipt key:
      • claim marker key
      • "1"
      • "EX"
      • claim marker TTL seconds
      • "NX"
    • Redis instance
  If exec result is missing, give back an object with found: false.
  Split exec result into get reply and set reply.
  Let get error be the first of get reply.
  Let set error be the first of set reply.
  If get error is set or set error is set, give back an object with found: false.
  Let raw be item #2 of get reply.
  Let claim result be item #2 of set reply.
  If raw is missing, give back an object with found: false.
  Let receipt be raw parsed from JSON.
  Let missing field be the first field in a list of "customer_id", "feature_id", and "items" where receipt's entry for field is missing.
  If missing field is set:
    Fail with an error: "Lock receipt is missing {missing field} for ID: {lock ID}" [error code's invalid request] (status 400).
  Normalize lock receipt items (items: receipt's items and lock ID), and put the result in receipt's items.
  Give back an object with:
    • found: true
    • claimed: whether claim result is "OK"
    • receipt
    • lock receipt key
    • Redis instance

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/deductionV2/deductionToTrackResponseV2.ts

    • feature ID: feature deduction's feature's ID

    then:
      Give back 1.
    If all of these are true:
      • left's type is not feature type's credit system
      • right's type is feature type's credit system

      Give back negative 1.
    Give back 0.

  Let credit system be the first feature in relevant features where feature's ID is not feature deduction's feature's ID.

  Give back an object with balance: nothing and balances.

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/deductionV2/mutationLogsToFeaturesV2.ts

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/deduction/resolveOverageAllowance.ts
“Whether a row may go below zero, and where it sits in the overage pass. A row with its own overage (a usage price, a plan or customer control) takes overage before a free allocated grant, so a priced add-on bills the units a free plan's grant would otherwise absorb.”

  Let control enables overage mean overage allowed control's enabled is set and feature has native overage is false.
  Let has own overage mean any of these is true:
    • unlimited is true
    • all of these are true:
      • control vetoes overage is false
      • control enables overage is true or customer entitlement's usage allowed is set
  Let free allocated may run over mean all of these are true:
    • control vetoes overage is false
    • overage behaviour is not "reject"
    • customer entitlement is free
    • customer entitlement is allocated
  If has own overage, give back an object with usage allowed: true and overage priority: 0.
  If free allocated may run over is true, give back an object with usage allowed: true and overage priority: 1.
  Give back an object with usage allowed: false and overage priority: 2.

##### server/src/internal/balances/utils/allocatedInvoice/compute/computeUpdateCustomerEntitlementPlan.ts
To compute update customer entitlement plan — given billing context; gives back an UpdateCustomerEntitlement (or nothing):
  From billing context, take customer entitlement, previous usage, new usage, previous overage, and new overage.
  “1. Compute autumn billing plan”
  Let is upgrade be an allocated invoice is upgrade (billing context).
  If is upgrade:
    “Plan for upgrade”
    Let new overage usage be new overage minus previous overage.
    Let replaceables to delete be the first new overage usage of customer entitlement's replaceables.
    Give back an object with:
      • customer entitlement
      • balance change: the number of replaceables to delete
      • deleted replaceables: replaceables to delete
  “Downgrade case”

    “Just return”

  Otherwise:
    “Plan for downgrade”
    Let customer price be the customer price of customer entitlement (given error on not found).
    From the proration config of customer price's price (given is upgrade), take should create replaceables.
    If should create replaceables:
      Let number replaceables to create be the larger of 0 and previous usage minus new usage.
      Give back an object with:
        • customer entitlement
        • balance change: negative number replaceables to create
        • insert replaceables: an object with length: number replaceables to create as a list, each turned into an object with:
          • ID: generate ID ("rep")
          • customer entitlement ID: customer entitlement's ID
          • created at: the current time
          • delete next cycle: true
    “When shouldCreateReplaceables is false, no customer entitlement update, but still do billing updates...”
    Give back an object with customer entitlement and balance change: 0.

##### server/src/internal/balances/track/utils/handlePostgresTrackError.ts
“Handles errors from Postgres deduction. Converts PostgreSQL INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE exception to InsufficientBalanceError.”
To handle postgres track error — given error and body:
  “Check if it's an insufficient balance error from PostgreSQL Format: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE|featureId:{id}|value:{amount}|remaining:{remaining}”
  If "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE" is in error's message:
    Let parts be error's message split on "|".
    Match item #2 of parts (/featureId:(.*)/), and call the result feature ID match.
    Match item #3 of parts (/value:(.*)/), and call the result value match.
    Let feature ID be item #2 of feature ID match, or body's feature ID if that's empty.
    Let value be depending on whether item #2 of value match is set:
      • if so: parse float [Number] (item #2 of value match)
      • if not: body's value, or 1 if that's missing
    Fail with an insufficient balance error.
  “Rethrow all other errors”
  Fail with error.

##### server/src/internal/balances/track/deductUtils/calculateDeduction.ts
Type CalculateDeductionParams: an object.
Type CalculateDeductionResult: an object.

To calculate deduction — given current balance, current adjustment, amount to deduct, min balance, max balance, and alter granted balance (default false); gives back a CalculateDeductionResult:
  Let is refund mean amount to deduct is negative.
  Start with no deducted yet.
  Start with no new balance yet.
  If is refund:
    Let amount to add be amount to deduct's negated.
    Let max addable be depending on whether max balance is missing:
      • if so: amount to add
      • if not: the larger of 0 and max balance minus current balance
    Let added be the smaller of amount to add and max addable.
    Set deducted to negative added.
    Set new balance to current balance plus added.
  Otherwise:
    Let max deductible be depending on whether min balance is missing:
      • if so: amount to deduct
      • if not: the larger of 0 and current balance minus min balance
    Set deducted to the smaller of amount to deduct and max deductible.
    Set new balance to current balance minus deducted.
  Let remaining be amount to deduct minus deducted.
  “Update adjustment if alterGrantedBalance is true”
  Let new adjustment start as current adjustment.
  If alter granted balance is true and deducted is not 0, set new adjustment to current adjustment minus deducted.
  Give back an object with:
    • deducted
    • new balance
    • new adjustment
    • remaining

“Runs a single deduction pass over customer entitlements, tracking updates and mutation logs. Extracted to avoid duplicating the per-cusEnt loop logic across passes. Also exported for reuse by callers that need the "paydown primitive" — e.g. the auto top-up rebalancer uses a single pass with `maxBalance: 0` and a negative `amountToDeduct` to heal overage'd cusEnts up to (but not past) zero.”

      • adjustment: customer entitlement's adjustment, or 0 if that's missing

      • previous customer entitlement

##### server/src/internal/balances/track/deductUtils/deductFromMainBalance.ts
Type DeductFromMainBalanceParams: an object.
Type DeductFromMainBalanceResult: an object.

“Deducts from the main balance of a customer entitlement. Handles three cases: 1. Entity-scoped, all entities - loops through all entities 2. Entity-scoped, single entity - deducts from specific entity 3. Top-level balance - deducts from cusEnt.balance”
To deduct from main balance — given customer entitlement, amount to deduct, target entity ID, min balance, max balance, alter granted balance (default false), and allow overage (default false); gives back a DeductFromMainBalanceResult:
  If allow overage is false:
    Set min balance to min balance, or the min balance of customer entitlement if that's missing.
    Let usage allowed be the usage allowed of customer entitlement.
    Set min balance to 0 if usage allowed is missing, otherwise min balance.
  Let current top level balance be customer entitlement's balance, or 0 if that's missing.
  Let current top level adjustment be customer entitlement's adjustment, or 0 if that's missing.
  Let current entities be customer entitlement's entities, or nothing if that's missing.
  Let base max balance be the starting balance of customer entitlement.
  If target entity ID is set or customer entitlement is entity scoped:
    “CASE 1: ENTITY SCOPED, SINGLE ENTITY”
    If target entity ID is set:
      Let entity be current entities' entry for target entity ID.
      If entity is set:
        Let entity balance be entity's balance, or 0 if that's missing.
        Let entity adjustment be entity's adjustment, or 0 if that's missing.
        Let resolved max balance be nothing if allow overage is true; otherwise max balance, or base max balance plus entity adjustment if that's missing.
        Calculate deduction, and take its deducted, new balance, new adjustment, and remaining:
          • current balance: entity balance
          • current adjustment: entity adjustment
          • amount to deduct
          • alter granted balance
          • min balance
          • max balance: resolved max balance
        Let new entities be current entities, but with:
          • [target entity ID] set to an object with:
            • ID: target entity ID
            • balance: new balance
            • adjustment: new adjustment
            • additional balance: 0
        Give back an object with:
          • deducted
          • new balance
          • new entities
          • new adjustment
          • remaining
      Give back an object with:
        • deducted: 0
        • new balance: current top level balance
        • new entities: current entities
        • new adjustment: current top level adjustment
        • remaining: amount to deduct
    “CASE 2: ENTITY SCOPED, ALL ENTITIES”
    Let original amount to deduct be amount to deduct.
    Let new entities be an object with everything in current entities.
    For each key entity ID in current entities:
      Stop the loop if amount to deduct is 0.
      Let entity be current entities' entry for entity ID.
      Let entity balance be entity's balance, or 0 if that's missing.
      Let entity adjustment be entity's adjustment, or 0 if that's missing.
      Let resolved max balance be nothing if allow overage is true; otherwise max balance, or base max balance plus entity adjustment if that's missing.
      Calculate deduction, and take its new balance, new adjustment, and remaining:
        • current balance: entity balance
        • current adjustment: entity adjustment
        • amount to deduct
        • alter granted balance
        • min balance
        • max balance: resolved max balance
      Set amount to deduct to remaining.
      Set new entities' entry for entity ID to entity, but with balance set to new balance and adjustment set to new adjustment.
    Let deducted be original amount to deduct minus amount to deduct.
    Give back an object with:
      • deducted
      • new balance: current top level balance
      • new adjustment: current top level adjustment
      • new entities
      • remaining: amount to deduct
  “CASE 3: TOP-LEVEL BALANCE”
  Let resolved max balance be nothing if allow overage is true; otherwise max balance, or base max balance plus current top level adjustment if that's missing.
  Calculate deduction, and take its deducted, new balance, new adjustment, and remaining:
    • current balance: current top level balance
    • current adjustment: current top level adjustment
    • amount to deduct
    • alter granted balance
    • min balance
    • max balance: resolved max balance
  Give back an object with:
    • deducted
    • new balance
    • new entities: current entities
    • new adjustment
    • remaining

##### server/src/internal/balances/shadow/createBalanceShadow.ts
“What the shadow reports per track: the verdict, and the rows it drew from as they stand after it.”
To summarize reply — given reply:
  From reply, take result and state.
  Let drawn row IDs be the unique values of the IDs of result's deltas.
  Let remaining be state's customer entitlements, plus state's rollovers, after these steps:
    1. Keep only those where row's ID is in drawn row IDs
    2. The total balance across ␀them
  Give back an object with:
    • revision: state's revision
    • status: result's status
    • remaining: remaining if drawn row IDs' size is positive (otherwise nothing)
    • applied value: negative the total value delta across result's deltas

To create balance shadow — given dependencies and limits (default an object with max pending: 256, concurrency: 4, and timeout ms: 2000); gives back a BalanceShadow:
  If any of these is true:
    • the values in limits has a value where value is not safe integer [Number] or value is zero or less
    • limits' concurrency is more than limits' max pending
  then:
    Fail with a range error: "Invalid shadow delivery limits".
  Let queue be an empty list.
  Let jobs be an empty lookup table.
  Let active customers be an empty set.
  Let counts be an object with:
    • submitted: 0
    • completed: 0
    • failed: 0
    • dropped: 0
  Start with no scheduled yet.
  Let stopped mean false.
  Start with no stopping yet.
  To record — given event:
    Try the following:
      Report dependencies (event).
    If anything fails, ignore it.
  Status:
    Give back counts, but with pending set to the number of queue and in flight set to jobs' size.
  To drop — given track and reason:
    Increase counts' dropped by 1.
    Record:
      • everything in track's command's identity
      • request ID: track's command's request ID
      • command ID: track's command's command ID
      • feature ID: track's command's feature ID
      • event: "dropped"
      • reason
  To schedule:
    If stopped is true, scheduled is set, or queue is empty, stop here.
    Set immediate (pump), and put the result in scheduled.
  Deliver — given track and controller (async):
    Let started at be performance's now.
    Let context be track's command's identity, but with:
      • request ID set to track's command's request ID
      • command ID set to track's command's command ID
      • feature ID set to track's command's feature ID
      • value set to track's command's value
      • source set to track's source
    Let timer be after limits' timeout msms, do the following:
      controller.abort(new Error("Shadow delivery timeout"))
    Try the following:
      Throw controller's signal if aborted.
      Track dependencies' client (command: track's command and signal: controller's signal), and call the result reply.
      Summarize reply (reply), and call the result shadow.
      Increase counts' completed by 1.
      Record:
        • everything in context
        • event: "completed"
        • duration ms: performance's now minus started at
        • shadow
    If anything fails (call the problem error):
      Increase counts' failed by 1.
      Record:
        • everything in context
        • event: "failed"
        • duration ms: performance's now minus started at
        • reason: error's message if error is an error, otherwise "unknown_failure"
    Either way, finally:
      Clear timeout (timer).
  Pump:
    Set scheduled to nothing.
    Keep repeating while stopped is false, jobs' size is less than limits' concurrency, and queue is not empty:
      Let index be the position of the first item in queue where the partition key of command's identity is not in active customers (or -1).
      Stop the loop if index is negative 1.
      Split queue's splice (index and 1) into track.
      Let customer key be the partition key of track's command's identity.
      Add customer key to active customers.
      Let controller be a new abort controller.
      Let job be nothing, then (with the result as item) a deliver (track and controller)'s finally:
        • a function that:
          Remove controller from jobs.
          Remove customer key from active customers.
          Schedule.
      Record job under controller in jobs.
  To submit — given track; gives back true/false:
    If stopped is true or the number of queue plus jobs' size is at least limits' max pending:
      Drop (track and reason: "stopped" if stopped is true, otherwise "queue_full").
      Give back whether false.
    Add a deep copy of track to queue.
    Increase counts' submitted by 1.
    Record:
      • everything in track's command's identity
      • request ID: track's command's request ID
      • command ID: track's command's command ID
      • feature ID: track's command's feature ID
      • event: "queued"
    Schedule.
    Give back whether true.
  To stop:
    If stopping is set, give back stopping.
    Set stopped to true.
    If scheduled is set, Clear immediate (scheduled).
    For each track in queue's splice (0):
      Drop (track and reason: "shutdown").
    For each controller in jobs' keys:
      Run controller's abort (an error: "Shadow stopped; in-flight result may be unknown").
    Set stopping to the results of doing these at the same time (carrying on even if some fail)'s then:
      • all of jobs' values
      • a function that:
        Record (event: "stopped" and everything in status).
    Give back stopping.
  Give back an object with:
    • submit
    • record
    • status
    • stop

##### server/src/internal/balances/shadow/createBalanceShadowController.ts

      Settle (jobs).

      If config's expires at is at or before the current time, stop here.
      Start session (config), and put the result in session.
    If anything fails (call the problem error):
      Report failure (error).
    Either way, finally:
      If generation is current generation, set pending to nothing.
  To stop current session:
    Let previous be session.
    Set session to nothing.
    Try the following:
      Give back stop previous, or nothing if that's missing.
    If anything fails (call the problem error):
      Report failure (error).
      Give back nothing.
  To refresh:
    If started is false or stopped is true, give back nothing.
    Start with no config yet.
    Try the following:
      Parse balance shadow edge config (input: read config and runtime env), and put the result in config.
    If anything fails (call the problem error):
      Report failure (error).
    Let key be config as JSON if config is set (otherwise nothing).
    If all of these are true:
      • key is desired key
      • any of these is true:
        • pending is set
        • config is missing
        • session is set and session is not stopped
    then:
      Give back pending, or nothing if that's missing.
    Set desired key to key.
    Let current generation be increase generation by 1.
    Stop current session, and call the result previous.
    Apply config (config, current generation, and jobs: a list of pending and previous), and put the result in pending.
    Give back pending.
  To start:
    If started is true or stopped is true, stop here.
    Set started to true.
    Nothing.
  To stop:
    If stopping is set, give back stopping.
    Set stopped to true.
    Increase generation by 1.
    Settle (jobs: a list of pending and stop current session), and put the result in stopping.
    Give back stopping.
  Give back an object with:
    • start
    • refresh
    • get session: a function giving back depending on whether all of these are true:
      • session is set
      • session is not stopped

      • if not: nothing
    • stop

##### server/src/internal/balances/replay/targets/validateReplayDatabaseUrl.ts
Let multi host separator be ",".
Let minimum tcp port be 1.
Let maximum tcp port be 65,535.

To parse database URL — given database URL; gives back an URL:
  Try the following:
    Give back a new URL (database URL).
  If anything fails:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url is not a parsable connection url".

To assert supported scheme — given URL:
  If URL's protocol is not in replay database supported schemes:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url scheme "{URL's protocol with ":" replaced by ""}" is not a supported postgres scheme".

To assert single tcp host — given URL:
  If URL's hostname is empty, fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url must address a single tcp host".
  If multi host separator is in URL's hostname:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url must not list multiple hosts".

To assert database user — given URL:
  If URL's username is empty, fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url must supply a database user".

To assert supported query parameters — given URL:
  For each key in URL's search params' keys:
    Let normalized key be key in lowercase.
    If normalized key is in replay database routing query keys:
      Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url carries the routing override query parameter "{normalized key}"".
    If key is not in replay database allowed query keys:
      Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url carries an unsupported query parameter "{key}"".

To assert no URL fragment — given URL:
  If URL's hash is not empty, fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url must not carry a fragment".

To decode database segment — given segment; gives back text:
  Try the following:
    Decode uri component (segment), and give back the result.
  If anything fails:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url has an undecodable database path".

To resolve database name — given URL; gives back text:
  Let path be depending on whether URL's pathname starts with "/":
    • if so: URL's pathname from position 1 onward
    • if not: URL's pathname
  Let segments be path split on "/".
  If the number of segments is not 1 or the first of segments is empty:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url must address exactly one database".
  Decode database segment (segment: the first of segments), and give back the result.

To resolve database port — given URL; gives back a number:
  If URL's port is empty, give back replay staging default database port.
  Let port be URL's port as a number.
  Let is usable port mean port is a whole number, port is at least minimum tcp port, and port is at most maximum tcp port.
  If is not usable port, fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database url carries an invalid tcp port".
  Give back port.

To assert matches database policy — given resolved and policy:
  If resolved's hostname is not policy's hostname in lowercase:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database host "{resolved's hostname}" is not the trusted replay database host".
  If resolved's port is not policy's port:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database port {resolved's port} is not the trusted replay database port {policy's port}".
  If resolved's database is not policy's database:
    Fail with a replay staging target error: "replay database "{resolved's database}" is not the trusted replay database "{policy's database}"".

To validate replay database URL — given database URL and policy; gives back a ReplayStagingDatabaseTarget:
  Parse database URL (database URL) → URL.
  Assert supported scheme (URL).
  Assert single tcp host (URL).
  Assert database user (URL).
  Assert supported query parameters (URL).
  Assert no URL fragment (URL).
  Let resolved be an object with:
    • hostname: URL's hostname in lowercase
    • port: resolve database port (URL)
    • database: resolve database name (URL)
  Assert matches database policy (resolved and policy).
  Give back resolved.

  If seen brokers' size is not the number of replay staging brokers:

Matching the policy is not proof that the policy itself addresses staging infrastructure, and this guard is not authorization to run a replay: the operator must still verify the policy against the staging inventory before execution.”

Let replay manifest input schema be a schema for an object with baseline, window, and requests.
Type ReplayRequestEnvelope: a z.infer.
Type ReplayManifestInput: a z.infer.

To describe manifest issues — given issues; gives back text:
  Let descriptions be an empty list.
  For each issue in issues:
    Let path be issue's path, after these steps:
      1. Pass each one through string
      2. Join them with "."
    Add "{path}: {issue's message}" if path is not empty, otherwise issue's message to descriptions.
  Give back descriptions joined with "; ".

To parse manifest input — given input; gives back a ReplayManifestInput:
  Let result be replay manifest input schema's safe parse (input).
  If result's success is missing:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "invalid replay manifest: {describe manifest issues (issues: result's error's issues)}".
  Give back result's data.

To assert ordered window — given window:
  If window's end ms is less than window's start ms:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "invalid replay manifest: the archive window ends before it starts".

To assert unique request IDs — given envelopes:
  Let seen IDs be an empty set.
  For each envelope in envelopes:
    If envelope's ID is in seen IDs:
      Fail with a replay manifest error: "invalid replay manifest: duplicate replay request id "{envelope's ID}"".
    Add envelope's ID to seen IDs.

To resolve logical run end ms — given baseline and window; gives back a number:
  Let logical run end ms be baseline's captured at ms plus window's end ms minus window's start ms.
  If logical run end ms is not safe integer [Number]:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "invalid replay manifest: the rebased run end leaves the safe integer range".
  Give back logical run end ms.

To assert archived within window — given envelope and window:
  Let is inside window mean all of these are true:
    • envelope's archived at ms is at least window's start ms
    • envelope's archived at ms is at most window's end ms
  If is not inside window:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "replay request "{envelope's ID}" was archived outside the manifest window".

To resolve logical timestamp ms — given envelope, baseline, and window; gives back a number:
  Let logical timestamp ms be baseline's captured at ms plus envelope's archived at ms minus window's start ms.
  If logical timestamp ms is not safe integer [Number]:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "replay request "{envelope's ID}" rebases outside the safe integer range".
  Give back logical timestamp ms.

To apply envelope customer ID — given body and envelope:
  If body has no replay body customer ID field key:
    Set body's entry for replay body customer ID field to envelope's customer ID.
    Stop here.
  If body's entry for replay body customer ID field is not envelope's customer ID:
    Fail with a replay manifest error: "replay request "{envelope's ID}" body customer_id does not match the archived envelope customer".

To build request body — given envelope and logical timestamp ms; gives back a ReplayRequestBody:
  Let body be a deep copy of envelope's body.
  Apply envelope customer ID (body and envelope).
  If envelope's operation is "track", set body's entry for replay body timestamp field to logical timestamp ms.
  Give back body.

To build archive provenance — given envelope and window; gives back a ReplayArchiveProvenance:
  Give back an object with:
    • archived at ms: envelope's archived at ms
    • archive window start ms: window's start ms
    • archive window end ms: window's end ms

To build manifest request — given envelope, baseline, and window; gives back a ReplayManifestRequest:
  Assert archived within window (envelope and window).
  Resolve logical timestamp ms (envelope, baseline, and window) → logical timestamp ms.
  Give back an object with:
    • ID: envelope's ID
    • org ID: envelope's org ID
    • env: envelope's env
    • customer ID: envelope's customer ID
    • operation: envelope's operation
    • logical timestamp ms
    • provenance: build archive provenance (envelope and window)
    • body: build request body (envelope and logical timestamp ms)

To build manifest requests — given envelopes, baseline, and window; gives back a list of ReplayManifestRequest:
  Let requests be an empty list.
  For each envelope in envelopes:
    Add build manifest request (envelope, baseline, and window) to requests.
  Give back requests.

To parse replay manifest — given input; gives back a ReplayManifest:
  Parse manifest input (input), and call the result parsed.
  Assert ordered window (window: parsed's window).
  Assert unique request IDs (envelopes: parsed's requests).
  Resolve logical run end ms (baseline: parsed's baseline and window: parsed's window) → logical run end ms.
  Build manifest requests → requests:
    • envelopes: parsed's requests
    • baseline: parsed's baseline
    • window: parsed's window
  Give back an object with:
    • baseline: an object with everything in parsed's baseline
    • window: an object with everything in parsed's window
    • logical run end ms
    • requests: requests
